subject: Trump's mail-in ballot endgame

body:
Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. With MAGA angling for total control, Trump wants to end their use forever.
Fuel our work with $35 or more right now to help defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062126_3&amount=50]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can to fight their unending desire for control and protect mail-in voting? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062126_3&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina.
If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections.
I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional.
We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Let me introduce myself.
I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty.
I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children.
In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again.
But then Trump’s chaos came back.
And Lindsey Graham? He cheered.
The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting.
So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham.
I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

subject: The lessons my father taught me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alex Kelloff for Colorado
body:
https://alexkelloff.com/ [https://alexkelloff.com/]
Friend,
On Father's Day, I'm thinking about my dad and the values he passed down to me. He taught me something I've carried with me my entire life:
"Do well, so that you can do good."
https://alexkelloff.com/ [https://alexkelloff.com/]
He's lived by those words. For nearly 60 years, he's served at the National Institutes of Health, and at 83 years old, he still goes to work every day.
Growing up, I learned that no job was beneath you. I mowed lawns, shoveled snow, and worked construction. I attended public schools, worked my way through college, and learned the value of showing up and doing my part.
Those experiences gave me a deep appreciation for this place we call home.
I'm grateful for the generations that came before me and for the values they passed on. And I'm hopeful about the future we're building for the generations that come next.
To all the fathers, grandfathers, stepfathers, and mentors who have helped shape our lives, thank you.
Happy Father's Day.
— Alex Kelloff

I ran for office on a simple promise: to listen closely to the people I represent and bring their voices into the work of the legislature. That commitment hasn’t changed. body:
What fathers teach us, what voters decide, and 5 days until Freedom Fest
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 21, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
First, happy Father's Day to all the dads, grandfathers, stepdads, mentors, coaches, and father figures in our community.
This weekend, we published a [collection of stories from our writers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) reflecting on the lessons their fathers taught them. Some talked about work ethic. Some talked about faith. Some talked about resilience. And some simply talked about showing up.
One contributor wrote that the greatest lesson his father taught him was that "love is most meaningful when it is chosen." Another reflected on a WWII veteran father who never missed a game when he wasn't traveling for work. Others remembered fathers who taught them to stand up for themselves, think differently, work harder, and stay present.
The common thread wasn't politics. [It was legacy.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The values we pass on. The example we set. And the responsibility we have to leave things better than we found them. Which is also why I want to encourage you to _**consider[Freedom Fest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a Father's Day gift this year.**_
In just 5 days, we'll gather in Castle Rock for two days celebrating faith, freedom, family, and the values that built this country. Whether it's the rodeo, the Curtis Grimes concert, Greg Gutfeld, the candidate meet-and-greet, the Family Fun Festival, or the incredible lineup of speakers like Nick Shirley, DOG the Bounty Hunter, and Tina Peters, it's an experience designed for the whole family. And kids 17 and under now receive free Bronze Pass admission with a ticketed adult.
**We're also launching a special initiative this week for veterans, Gold Star families, active-duty military members, and first responders.** Several generous donors have stepped forward to sponsor tickets for those who may not otherwise be able to attend. We'll be selecting a number of recipients (first come, first served) because we want Freedom Fest to honor the people who have sacrificed for our freedoms. 👉 _**[Nominate someone here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
🗳️ As ballots begin arriving in mailboxes across Colorado, many voters are still deciding who deserves their vote. That's why RMV spent the past several months interviewing candidates, covering debates, reviewing records, and asking the questions our readers wanted answered. We've pulled all of that reporting into _**[one comprehensive voter guide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ —covering the governor's race, attorney general, secretary of state, treasurer, key legislative contests, and more—to help you make the most informed decision possible before returning your ballot.
If your ballot is still sitting on the kitchen counter, take some time this week to [review the races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before returning it. Colorado ballots must be returned by 7 p.m. on June 30.
**Finally, Freedom Fest is officially just 5 days away.**
Over the next several days, we'll be sharing more videos from speakers across our social media channels and here on the newsletter so you can get a preview of what's coming. Keep an eye on Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube as we roll out interviews, clips, behind-the-scenes content, and speaker highlights.
The countdown is on. We can't wait to celebrate with you.

👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
---
[FREEDOM FEST TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Colorado rebuilt how it votes twice. Its federal plan never caught up.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold has called the state’s switch to mail-in voting a transformation of democracy. The federal election plan Colorado keeps on file describes an election system mostly built around precinct polling places. Both come from the state.
**[Wolf opponents ask federal officials to revisit Prop 114 after Keshel report challenges 2020 result](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The fight over Colorado wolves has landed in a federal review process. Opponents of wolf reintroduction are asking federal officials to reconsider Colorado’s wolf program after submitting a report that claims Proposition 114 did not actually pass.
**[Lara Logan: Why ordinary people still give her hope](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A few weeks after walking out of a Colorado prison, Tina Peters will take the stage at RMV Freedom Fest. Lara Logan will follow her to the microphone. After decades covering wars, terrorism, government corruption and some of the biggest stories in the world, Logan still talks most about people like Peters.
|
---
**STATE**
**[Colorado is cutting funding for its poorest students. The tool meant to replace it was suspended.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In Colorado’s smallest school districts, the ones tucked into rural towns, two state programs direct extra money each year to districts based on how many students live in poverty. They are not a lot, but they are specific. They are meant for those kids. And they are going away.

**[ICE detention cases are surging in Colorado. The DOJ keeps losing the legal fight.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Five people filed habeas corpus petitions challenging their Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention in all of Colorado federal court in 2024. One hundred five filed in 2025. Through June 15th of this year, 722 have filed, and the pace has held at more than 150 a month since March.

**[Beverly Aikins on faith, recovery and the next right thing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Hillbilly Elegy made her a character in her son's book. Ten years into recovery, the nurse and grandmother is telling it herself—and bringing it to the RMV Freedom Fest on June 26.

_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[DPS Fires Teacher After Students Report Pressure To Participate In Same Sex Kissing Skits](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools board members voted unanimously May 20 to dismiss a 50-year-old foreign language teacher following a district investigation and an independent review into student complaints about a class assignment.

**[DU Restructures as Enrollment Falls 19 Percent From Pandemic Peak](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Odifure Udegbe walked the stage Friday to chorus of whoops and hollers as he received his Master’s in Science degree from the University of Denver. Originally from Nigeria, Udegbe said he enrolled at DU to make himself more competitive in a tough job market.
**[New Analysis Examines Why Homelessness Is Concentrated in Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE BUSINESS TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) As the Grand Junction City Council debated whether to amend city code to strengthen enforcement of the camping ordinance, questions about shelter capacity and the size of the local homeless population took on new importance.
**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Temper, temper](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARK SALLEY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The Left is having a temper tantrum over America250. The babysitters spent the last 10 to 20 years...letting the children do exactly what they wanted. The children didn’t like mommy’s and daddy’s rules. So the babysitters, rather than enforcing the time-tested rules, let the children break them. And, break the rules they did. They left behind civility, honesty and responsibility._
__
**[An open letter to the 10th Circuit on free speech and the First Amendment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Similar to what Lincoln said of himself — I’m a slow walker but I don’t walk backwards — I often get busy with life and have to shelve writing projects without letting them go. I wrote back in early May about a decision rendered by the 10th Circuit Court of Appeals on legislative immunity._
__
**[Know your judges: New Mesa County appointment highlights Colorado’s selection process](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Per the article linked first below, Gov. Polis back in early May appointed a new judge in the Mesa County Judicial District. Quoting with link intact: “Effective on July 1, 2026, Courtney L. Dinnel will serve as a Mesa County Court Judge. The appointment was made to fill a new judgeship created by SB25-024, which increased the number of judges in certain county courts, including Mesa County’s, by one.”_ __
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[School Board Pays $95K After Censoring Student Tribute to Charlie Kirk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE CHRISTIAN POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A North Carolina school district has agreed to pay $95,000 in attorneys’ fees and damages after censoring an on-campus student tribute to conservative Christian activist Charlie Kirk.

**[Trump Refuses FISA Extension Without Voter ID and Citizenship Measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE WESTERN JOURNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Donald Trump said Monday that he will not support an extension of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act unless it includes his election integrity measure, the Save America Act.

**[World Cup Visitors Discover Heartland Hospitality and American Traditions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Christopher Columbus made his name over 500 years ago, but a new crop of Europeans is discovering America during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, posting rave reviews of comfort food and rural hospitality on social media.

_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133757757/629006350/1231236074?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.21_VotedNo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmM2YTgzNi1lMjZkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TPbZI9gx3Mm3bvWScqYu2LEcLQJSqNsJwwPkoC2IPB8=&emci=15d09b3c-ce6d-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=9fc6a836-e26d-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=23483442) | Peter, I voted **NO** on the Republican budget. Families across WA-06 are struggling with the cost of groceries, gas, housing, child care, and health care. **Congress should be focused on making life more affordable for working people.** Instead, Republicans put forward a budget that does nothing to lower costs for families.
* **Nothing to lower gas prices.**
* **Nothing to lower grocery costs.**
* **Nothing to lower health care costs.**
* **Nothing to lower child care costs.**

Peter,
Last week, the FBI raided an Ohio voting rights organization and now we just learned they're taking it a step further.
Federal agents descended on the Cleveland office of the Ohio Organizing Collaborative, a grassroots group which has helped hundreds of thousands of Ohioans register to vote. They seized phones and computers from the staff.
They did not stop there. More than 100 agents fanned out across the entire state. They showed up at the homes of organizers and activists tied to the group in Cleveland, Columbus, Cincinnati, Dayton, and Youngstown, and interrogated them about "voter fraud."

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1938, Joe Louis knocked out Germany's Max Schmeling in the first round of their heavyweight title rematch at Yankee Stadium, a 124-second rout watched by 70,000 fans and heard by millions on the radio. With war looming in Europe, the bout became one of the most symbolic sporting events in history. ([Watch Footage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVvQcXYMGTxUilJ1SNVOHdFhH8GJwREYrLx9RV-h6_dJv-H_c22v5IOfbp80skl9bCfOS-CUeG79TFOm8FjimpZ1HHm-x26hybUIqA-gD4itIx9erSqc6ZmRZcGmqhusEBtdFYMhpYAAreWuOcoj9r1zR6odWLYIqApvdg00YgVQKyhPJ82dQytdTU5qFArY-RTn8h79lAbuwytuPJc2jkUwQ0rPRcg3gReBl5xz-YprWjve_32hZAchL5uQ5-_T_YEfX9v5vSlm457Zh-AXXQsFt5F8-CPTvzpsBn8DAAD__8ziccU)) Elmo is back in the headlines, and this time he's learned his lesson. ## Iran Talks Collapse in Switzerland
Iran's negotiating team [walked out of peace talks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFygzAQRL8GOjHSCQtTqEhD57QpmQMdRo6QGOlsxvn6DPmFtLs7O_v26zbe0Acf75-4keUljZGOEoiZ8ugzxgPDd0lPLs9to_xIU8HoRpBghDQCYHTow3tsa2cXIiBdk1XdFRTA1ah6taojg_OsFzldUPdT2yvtUJJuO9VeFNXenm3SACgpu1Y2fW9ocjBr16HTBqpWkvOccvNIPvJKS3inF-VmTlsd7Mq8l0p_VDBUMBzH0cRpPilO_1RSDq6C4aSpYNgzFe8osng48cI4kyiH5x_KAaMTZ0rwCS04P7dd8JoJmWIRnEIQeY6oL0pqXWfr9sOH4IvpqlbeN_ThbxP_68iXhd8AAAD__zUdilY) in Switzerland on Sunday, just 80 minutes into the first face-to-face session under the deal signed last week. Iranian state media blamed an "insulting message" from President Trump. Trump told reporters he had warned Iranian officials they ["won't even make it back"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGS2zAMRU9DdfBQsJeUCxZp1G3alBpYhCxuKMJDQnac02eUK2yDBjPv__d_fU6flHIq95-0cdBFpsKvllmV65QqlRfl3012bfu2cf2SW6MSJ7TowDpAnCKl_J4uXQwLM_K549D7AXvEwfXdGtwtIrL_6Mn38-0jDjP7wQ3W-aW_LmS7FA6adYi9tf5iT9er41vE-Rw9xbNDc7Eck0o9fUkquvKS3_Lkeppl63JYVR_NnH8YHA2O5f2QpsfL4HiADY72ONgbHF9Sc4RD0eCodd8eoGtlUi4NVCBy0ypvOMzhyICmlZKCLLBK3fa_MGdpe2VYspA2QAv3nWpMVIDKnTMo_QEpICkbHLsa4uOVck7NeXOx941S_l9cv7X2M-C_AAAA__-FlZXS) to their country if they close the Strait of Hormuz, adding he would "blow the s--t out of them." Iran's parliament speaker fired back, writing that the country's armed forces "are ready to give them a response in a different way." Despite the blowup, sources told reporters that the Iranian delegation had not left Switzerland entirely and that back-channel talks were continuing. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGupDAQBNDTmMzINKxhAgebkM2mG6IGN-DZxka2GWv29F_8K_y4pFK9-vucnujY-e0PHmTyGiZPJTHlTHFyEX1B_pfCldN1HBRfYU7o7QQKtFRaAkwWHX-mrrJmJQJqKzJNP0ADMOim2s2qO7WooVvahtYFZ-wJh192aPp1HpoWKmfuNqUBGqX6TtWPh6bZwtLaHm2rQXSKrMsh1q_gfN5p5U94U6yXcFRs9pzPJNrfAkYBYymlXuZ0K-5cwMjuTfI6LWZKAsYbJa8kC0aZb5xMVzrJW7Iyx-s45REu6VJEYsk0ow9e7vR_Dsy4y9Vte3Z-EzBW0dizOGaXdC86tR3o-HtU_tGTbwNfAQAA__-Uq4vt).
## Starmer Expected to Resign
British Prime Minister Keir Starmer is [expected to announce](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ_GdEZmIIYULrahy7ZbIscekkn8g8YmKG-_4r7C7Y50pKPzff9uy81SoPT4ayOauuYl4VEC1oq8ENt02PAuea9ljxH5le_FJr-AAi2VlgCLtxS-y9B4syIC9g2abpygA5h01zzNtdMd6ql3qC9-wG4dL26arB_X6dLraW3InGtKA3RKjYNqr1eNdw-u96P1vQYxKPRUM7evTKk-cQ3f_EFuXY5NMM9atyL6PwJmAfNxHK27l5Pi7AXMZxQw72-5MUWUkRKViizfSCxLtRyR5Z48stwYS9kZJWOhR5JlQ0c2SAzoKuUkYG7Y-O2gEKjoUQzqES2Fnyv1V_4-Bv4HAAD__7vkh-4) a timetable to step down as early as Monday, after cabinet ministers, including his foreign and home secretaries, told him his time is up. The pressure mounted after Andy Burnham, the popular mayor of Greater Manchester, won a special election Thursday by a wide margin and [signaled he wants the top job](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwjAQxvGncTaiyyWczeChSza6dozs3AVMnRjFBos-fUVfofMn_aTv_3Wezi7EsF0-3Sq2LGnapOYopcg-hd1t1cXvnB4lP9ZV9lvy2W08ISAdgA6IE7sQX9PQsF1EUPpGbKcNdoiGuuZqjSM-DsRuBmEGWLwnc8RjhydNevFNsG8NCLED0AO0pxOJZ5x71o57QjWAcChpb28pbOUqS3ylp-ztnNYm2msp96z6D4WjwrHW2no_vzeF4_uMwjGGpygcZ0P652bAyKs0u-V7DTGGTFoNcFldiH9i-VeGp8XfAAAA____CnD1). President Trump got ahead of the announcement, [posting on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGngS0RHGPAA8OVrrylU6WO1rE5jkmxsQAnyttX7it0_T7pN_y_bsMNQwzb_QNXcnVOw0avEqlWykPIuL0wfpd01HKsK-VHGgtufgAB-iL0BWDwGOJ7UNy7mQio4eSksSABrJZ8cahbQJh9a60EoY3UHZGxap7mcSTT8eBOTWgAKYRR4tp1mkYPU-MN-kYDU4J8qClfHylsdaE5vtOT8nVKK49uqXUvrPnHoGfQ13zUpaQpYDz_c1QiE8b_acPoP_Ox7gz6PZVaGPRSamOtamVnWjBaguTZ-f0VYgxFG6bEfcXwS_H6pz5PBz8BAAD__8UQeAU) that Starmer "will resign" after failing on immigration and energy. British media reported the two had not spoken since last week's G7. If Starmer goes, he would be the sixth British prime minister to leave office in 10 years. Burnham is the overwhelming favorite to replace him.
## Reflecting Pool Arrests Mount
President Trump said police [arrested multiple people](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu2zAQRE9DdTKopUxZBYsAgbofpEsprMi1vc6SFEjahm8fKFf41RQDDOa9P1_rF7Jwuv3CSK5d85roXYVao7JywfRG-Vvzs9VnjFQeeauYwgoabK9tD7AGZPmsYxfclQjIdOSG6QIDwMUO3d3R4Dcz-Cuc0c7b5ulszDzpCT1cBnuxHbtjTVuAQetp1Kd5trQF8CZMGIwFNWoK3HI5PTKndqerfPKLysnn2Im7t7ZXZX4oWBQsuPmD4OgULL-zcGNfFSytPOPex6c03oX6nfIRWArVRqFHEbpR6F-YAgrX2AsnnyX1kWIujKJgqS2XjzILB2V-DmbU9jzOU1dc2N8swtVOatS3iCz_z7VvGX05-BcAAP__68CMlg) for vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, claiming saboteurs poured chemicals into the water and slashed the new lining. Officials said five people were arrested and five more received federal citations. Among them was [David Hearn](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOkdmICYpKLahe9tuiSaeIZm3YxvZTiL261fkF153pSMd3Xv_fC1fKCrx_hsDT3VNS-R3Ua6V8yIZ4xv1b0nPWp4hcP5Ot4KRFrDgjHUGYCEU3ZehpWllBu5bnrrxAh3AxXXtYxp9f_F0O8NqR0-Dv1o-0_Xc0Y3PI7mhlemwWQfQWTsO9nS9Or4R-J5GpN5BM1gmqSmfvpPE-uBV9_TifPIptDo9at1K0_9qYG5gjvuWSj1QA_MhbmC27pMbmJ_FHPsamDFwFo_RJN3DJt54jImlVEP4EjIPxhwN5sylMpk1ZYOqfGfS3bwwEqr8k3g3KtEnjSZwSFlQTeZV2deDbSlpmyfa3qIqxY3NYO8BRT_V64_-fk3wPwAA__-kSphF), a three-time Olympic canoeist who says he was handcuffed after merely touching a flap of blue sealant already peeling from the bottom. Trump said the pool will likely need to be [partially drained](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuO4zAQBNDTUJkMqqklxYDBJsq86YYCLbas9vAjkG0bvv1Ac4WJC3iFqv_X5eopUr7_8wkdb2XJ-G4RmbEuVH1--_jVypPbMyWsj3JrPocFJOhe6h5gCZ7iZxm74DZEQNWhG8wEA8Ckh253k7lZWFcYvLXTCKOxcjJ-VKsejLKD7MidmtQAg5RmlBdrNd4CrCoYH5QGMUoMxKVeHoUy77jFT3lhvawlddHtzEcT6q-AWcDMO-4U45kJmPeS8BwkYPYhUabG1TOVLGD-Y5WSE_Rcn-noK24RV6Z8749SYh-qp4yhr3h4qifQVReON8VITRsxynvy9NPT8a-Oezn4DgAA__8d2IKw) for repairs, weeks after the $14 million renovation was completed ahead of America's 250th birthday. The cause of the damage is disputed. Hearn told reporters he "didn't destroy or break or peel anything."

## San Antonio Approves Toyota Incentives
San Antonio's City Council [voted 11-0 Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ywyAQBOCnkTo06EA_KSjSuHPalMwJTjIzCDRwsa23z8TJG6T9it2d_bzaK4YY0vaBOxl-rtkmetRIzFQs0xNrwbRRqS5H77DSVwq8W5AwCjkKAOsxxNPq1ptF-re-JdNPM_Qw9npqb2adlcJ1keBmP6tllnpBiaDRzQPApNtgfsLkCND3EmDqnFIrjBqcH9QyuKHRknzgXDq-0WvSGs98p9K5vLfR3JiP2qj3Bi4NXComTJxTyIWOXLjLZftl8eei4qMKd1TB-cyMgp4HphpyauDSFuOPR4gx1HFqtNx2DPFVxP-7527gOwAA__8vwHve) to offer Toyota a package of tax breaks and utility incentives to land a $2 billion assembly line and 2,000 jobs on the city's South Side. I need you with me on this one, because there’s a bold voice fighting for Tennesseans

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/da3910ccbdec/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363685?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey y'all,I need you with me on this one, because there’s a bold voice fighting for Tennesseans that you need to know about.I know firsthand what happens when you stand up to MAGA. When you refuse to be quiet and instead demand accountability, their corporate political machine does everything in its power to silence you.That is why I am proudly endorsing **Kristi Burke** for U.S. House of Representatives in Tennessee's 1st District. Kristi is a grassroots candidate who stepped up to run after she was forcibly removed by police from incumbent Diana Harshbarger’s town hall just for asking a question. **Diana shut her out** , cancelled all subsequent town halls, and refused to listen to any of her constituents because she prefers serving billionaires and lobbyists over her own neighbors.
****Kristi is running without a dime of corporate PAC money coming her way. She is fighting unapologetically for rural healthcare, tax reform and relief for the working class, reproductive rights, and responsible conversations about data centers, among other non-negotiables.**But there is much more to do.** Many more voters that must be reached and shown they have a real choice in this election.Even if you do not live in Kristi’s district, this is a fight we can all get behind to try and reclaim our democracy from corporate capture and the rise of American fascism. You can volunteer even if you don’t live in the district by making calls or writing postcards. You can also help build financial resources in a BIG way so she can stand against Diana and her wealthy corporate donors, and we need to do it **right now**. ****So here’s how you can help:**Chip in $25 today** , or whatever you can, to help Kristi fight back at[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/votekristiburke](https://us.list-manage.com/8cGmQxiRAEG?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0). If you aren’t able to donate, you can also learn more about her campaign, view her website, volunteer, and follow her social media pages by visiting[ https://linktr.ee/votekristiburke](https://us.list-manage.com/TWcL733WqNd?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0).Can I count on you to stand with us in this fight?Rep. Gloria Johnson

At the end of this month, our Senate campaign will close the books on our most important FEC deadline yet. When it’s over, **we are legally required to report what we’ve raised so far in our efforts to flip Florida's Senate seat blue.** That includes the amount of individual donations.

No, not that one, though I'm definitely going to see the Odyssey when it comes out in a few weeks. Chris Nolan remains one of our greatest movie directors until proven otherwise. He made the Dark Knight and Inception. Tenet . . . we'll pretend that one didn't happen.
I'm talking about Todd Achilles, candidate for U.S. Senate out of Idaho. Yes, that's his real name.
Todd is running as an Independent after serving as a state legislator in Boise. "I served the country as a tank commander in the U.S. Army," Todd says. "Running for Senate is another way to serve."
Todd has done just about everything under the sun since returning from deployment to Kuwait 20-odd years ago. He got his MBA and became a senior telecom executive. He later became a public policy professor. Most recently, he was appointed as a state legislator in Idaho by the Democratic Governor. "I was one of 9 Democratic legislators in the state house," Todd observes. "There were 61 Republicans, so you get used to being in the minority to say the least."
Yet Todd notes that the vast majority of Idaho voters are frustrated. "Most Idahoans are just struggling to get by and they're increasingly fed up. They're not getting any kind of real results." Many are farmers whose costs went up because of the Trump tariffs.
The Republican incumbent is an 83-year-old Senator named Jim Risch. Yes, he's 83 now and trying to run again. "He hasn't done a single public town hall in 18 years," Todd says. It's a classic case of a DC legislator being completely insulated from any real competition.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e5059506-881c-4f62-8284-3a9a01628204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"Our polling shows us well ahead of the incumbent after people find out about me," Todd says. "I'm a numbers guy and we have a clear path to win." His most common conversation with Idaho voters goes like this:
"Hey, I'm Todd Achilles. I'm running for Senate."
Idaho voter - "Really? What party are you?"
Todd - "Neither. I'm running as an Independent."
Voter pauses. "I like it. I'll support you. We need someone like you."
It's a familiar pattern. In Idaho, running as a Democrat is a waste of time; Trump won the state by 36.5% over Harris in '24, for example. But anti-D.C. sentiment runs high. And Todd is tapping into that.
"I've pledged not to caucus with either party in D.C." Todd says. "Voters here know that they haven't gotten results and they're open to a different approach." If Todd can break through, it would be enormous not just for Idaho but for the country.
I told him he should make an ad patterned after [Brad Pitt](https://substack.com/redirect/2c98a354-fda5-4b76-b3d6-e05854577b4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Troy: "Independence - Take it, It's YOURS!!!!" Idaho only has 2 million people, but its Senate vote counts the same as any other state's. This is an overlooked race and a big opportunity.
For my convo with Todd Achilles, Independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Idaho, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/a5819aa8-e60a-4289-b2b7-12d925cfe1b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I've donated to Todd's [campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/372dd305-efd0-402a-a92a-64e54c53fceb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and I hope you'll check him out and consider [supporting](https://substack.com/redirect/372dd305-efd0-402a-a92a-64e54c53fceb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) him too. If Todd wins, he would have achieved immortality. One of my most cherished experiences is the time I spent counseling at Camp Kesem, where I worked with children whose parents are diagnosed with cancer as they deal with devastating circumstances. My fellow Camp Kesem counselor alumni are some of the most important people in my life, and they’re doing amazing things to change the world.
I wanted to chat with them about how young people are making major changes in our state and country, so next Monday (6/29), we’re going to connect, discuss, and take some questions at a virtual fundraiser from 6 pm-7 pm.
[**If you’re interested in joining us, please sign up here and help us build a campaign relentlessly dedicated to service, supporting others, and taking care of everyone in Wisconsin.**](https://us.list-manage.com/SXWicJ2gUp7?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)

I believe our next generation of leadership can fix broken systems, make concrete change in our communities, and strengthen the connections that hold us together. Thanks for being part of our campaign - I’ll see you on the trail soon!
Best,Dylan

# Six Weeks Out
---
| |
## _Join us on the campaign trail_
---
| | **Peter,****We’re six weeks out until election day! With early voting beginning last week, the first votes for Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs have officially been cast. And we couldn’t have made it this far without you. Ever call you made, every postcard you wrote, every door you knocked, and every dollar you chipped in helped us get to this point. But the job’s not finished yet.**
**We have another exciting week of events coming up. Elizabeth is participating in a**[**candidate forum hosted by Indivisible on Monday, June 22nd, from 6:00pm-7:00pm**](https://us.list-manage.com/rrhL0CS9AcO?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
**On Tuesday, June 23rd, we are holding a**[**fundraiser that will feature a panel of influential women**](https://us.list-manage.com/lsRdcKZvfeG?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**, including your next congresswoman, Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs. This event will take place at Ashland Theatre from 5:00pm-8:00pm.**
**On Friday, we are hosting a**[**virtual training on how to have tough conversations about politics**](https://us.list-manage.com/SlvaNxL7hzr?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. This will take place from 6:45pm-7:30pm, and will provide an opportunity for you to engage with our campaign staff, learn how you can make a difference, and enhance your understanding of the key issues driving our movement.**
**We are also continuing with our weekly**[**phone banks**](https://us.list-manage.com/_zrQhFmvv2v?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)** that will take place Tuesday, June 23rd, from 5:30pm-6:30pm, Thursday, June 24th, from 6:45pm-8:00pm, and Sunday, June 28th, from 2:00pm-4:00pm.**
**Additionally, we are opening up opportunities for all of our volunteers to knock doors in their neighborhoods on their own time. We understand that not everyone has the time or desire to drive to a canvass launch, so we are inviting you to knock doors in your communities whenever you want! If you are interested, simply email our operations director, Matthew Loew, at matthew@elizabethforvirginia.com. If you give him your name and address, he’ll give you a list of doors near you for you to knock and have impactful conversations with your neighbors.**

**We cannot thank you enough for everything you have contributed to this campaign. Together, we will move forward.**
**\- Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs**

# Monday, June 22, 2026
The Maestro takes his final bow, U.S. and Iran agree to a roadmap, Beijing punches back, and Starmer steps down.
---
| Just The TruthYour No-BS Conservative Newsletter⏱ 5-Minute Read • Monday EditionMonday, June 22, 2026⚡ Greenspan dies at 100 • U.S.–Iran agree to 60-day roadmap★ Lead Story
## The Maestro Takes His Final Bow: Alan Greenspan Dead at 100
Alan Greenspan, who ran the Federal Reserve for 18 years under four presidents and became the rare central banker known to ordinary Americans, died Monday morning at his Washington home. He was 100. His wife, NBC News correspondent Andrea Mitchell, confirmed he passed from complications of Parkinson's disease.What to Know
* ▸ Ronald Reagan appointed him in 1987; he stayed on through George H.W. Bush, Bill Clinton, and George W. Bush until 2006 — the second-longest Fed tenure in history.
* ▸ A libertarian Republican and onetime associate of "Atlas Shrugged" author Ayn Rand, he was hailed as the "Maestro" during the long boom of the 1990s.
* ▸ Critics later faulted his low-rate, light-regulation approach for helping inflate the 2008 housing crash; Greenspan himself admitted he had put too much faith in banks to police themselves.

The PerspectiveWhatever you make of the man, Greenspan was a free-market true believer at the helm of the world's most powerful central bank for nearly two decades — and the prosperity of the '90s was real. He was also big enough to own his mistakes, which is more than most in Washington ever manage. The honest verdict isn't sainthood or villainy; it's that one man's faith in markets shaped the American economy for a generation, for better and for worse. We'll let history weigh the ledger.Read the full story at [NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/T4g78rAmQiiVJsYo4QoFOl59X4QV96NikTZJGLGa4sEB5DMYkSFmQIjpavUR%0AZFp0QnoDz4YCXrw5r4p6w44l0UhSFtLM8nMbOzghrKF5Ysj6Rl%2FPJZ7FVxxA%0AQiWvORivsiuKpzQeDqG2d6id6JGiuY6Nv5Jj3UsgAWY7AvKGfHGHBQW1%2FdCf%0AbD6GHRVWzn3MvL9yZQfvAB2KLIYqSrdHSA%3D%3D%0A/b679fcc1ef7ad1a9).
* * *
★ The World Stage
## Tense Start, Cautious Finish: U.S. and Iran Agree to a Roadmap
The first round of high-level U.S.–Iran talks wrapped early Monday at Switzerland's Burgenstock resort above Lake Lucerne. Mediators Qatar and Pakistan announced the two sides had agreed on a roadmap toward a final deal within 60 days, plus a new communication line meant to keep the Strait of Hormuz open and avoid incidents.The Details
* ▸ Vice President JD Vance led the U.S. team; Iran's was led by parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf. Technical talks on the nuclear program, sanctions, and dispute resolution run the rest of the week.
* ▸ The opening was rocky. Trump warned online the U.S. would "hit Iran very hard again" over Hezbollah, and Tehran said it had again closed the Strait of Hormuz — the chokepoint for roughly 20% of the world's oil.
* ▸ Mediators called the progress "encouraging." Iran's foreign minister claimed movement on ending the fighting in Lebanon, restarting oil exports, and unfreezing Iranian assets.

The PerspectiveA roadmap is not a deal, and a deal is not peace. Talking is still better than another shooting war, and getting Iran to the table at all is no small thing. But the same week's headlines — a presidential threat to bomb, a closed Strait of Hormuz — are a reminder of how thin the ice is. We'll judge this one by what actually gets signed in 60 days, not by the photo-op in the Alps. No pom-poms here.Read the full story at [NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/wZhHNpjsYwVpQA%2BP1ph5NuBP7duLqPBYk42%2Fr0SnuyePgU0BBUhdGh4UgdXc%0AUUkdOVoolgGK6x7w63nUCjlYUwIVaeOwL5iLZyXMtYEjRX6g%2F92tWAPHGSgO%0AotRqeBJna0ptsJHlcgSInqghL5%2Bum%2FjJ%2F94XJ2D8%2BtsYvBr1maUWaAmDviXb%0A1IlKvdr9oeihWfZ1Lqma18QoQH5gbQCcHA%3D%3D%0A/11ad0f0509a9fd2f).
* * *
★ The Trade War
## Beijing Punches Back: China Sanctions 10 U.S. Defense Firms
China's Commerce Ministry on Monday barred Chinese companies from exporting "dual-use" goods — items with both civilian and military uses — to 10 American military-linked firms, including military-drone makers and rare-earth miners. It's retaliation for Washington adding Chinese tech giants to its own military blacklist.The Details
* ▸ Earlier this month the Pentagon added Alibaba, Baidu, BYD, and NIO to its list of firms it says aid China's military modernization. Baidu calls the label "totally baseless."
* ▸ Separately, China's Finance Ministry barred government buyers from purchasing from 46 U.S. companies, among them defense heavyweight Lockheed Martin.
* ▸ The move lands barely a month after Trump met Xi Jinping in Beijing and the two pledged to cool tensions. Analysts call it largely symbolic — but the rare-earth angle is the part worth watching.

The PerspectiveSo much for the springtime thaw. The Beijing handshake was always going to be tested the first time real interests collided, and here we are. Symbolic or not, China holds genuine leverage over rare earths and the supply chains underneath our defense industry — which is exactly why "decouple and rebuild at home" beats "trust Beijing's goodwill" every time. Friendly summits are fine. Self-reliance is better.Read the full story at [the Associated Press](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/hIyWwshQWDbc0sUsY9AVseSYwEoKCAmhUSmaaTqbESLyBLH3LtRT50MWxNq2%0AGQavHHbZLZcD01pud%2F8bIqEYNDm5%2ByT74FZuH1EspcljwofbRY5WIWLP%2Fe0M%0AvQ9837lpu6JQWxNRQg9XVFvXeEwDK0H%2B9pdms5YgkejInDd%2BYu1QL1pUMa5N%0AQGlRCGWomBz6V7TCvszLa6Ch%2BZpU1kNZZg%3D%3D%0A/f5dbe55ecbb68b2c).
* * *
★ Across the Pond
## Starmer Out: Britain Set for Its Seventh Leader in a Decade
U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced Monday outside 10 Downing Street that he will resign, after an uprising inside his own center-left Labour Party. His exit clears the way for Britain's seventh prime minister in ten years.The Takeaways
* ▸ Andy Burnham, the popular former mayor of Greater Manchester who only returned to Parliament last week, is the runaway favorite to succeed him and has confirmed he'll run.
* ▸ Starmer said he informed King Charles III and will stay on as caretaker until Labour selects a new leader.
* ▸ He swept into office less than two years ago in a landslide. The collapse since has been a stunning fall for Britain's governing left.

The PerspectiveTwo years from a landslide to the exit. Voters handed Labour the keys expecting competence and got revolving-door chaos instead — a familiar story when a governing party promises everything and delivers a stalled economy. There's a lesson here for politicians on both sides of the Atlantic: a mandate is a loan, not a gift, and the bill always comes due.Read the full story at [NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/h7g%2Bq9l4Xs505SUUv0%2FL7McBjms%2F%2FO%2ByUg983xVashXSotDzf0xaZZQMD8KN%0Ah8zRIGqGdOh40ET9Qj7mnE4njk1nmZ8r%2Bg6Vtba0NpCBxXrH%2FiLTLIepfhUz%0A%2BLH%2BnhfFCJSerzXm26AI7KK498wrIFhQgvCffPu88tG5O2R4LZdQd2cM1LYL%0AilOP8CrqM8Ax2%2BN0hZ%2BLs2icbKDraPzknw%3D%3D%0A/afe5b719c38431ee).⚡ The Bottom LineA giant of American capitalism passed on the same morning Washington sat across the table from Tehran and traded blows with Beijing — while a left-wing government across the Atlantic quietly imploded. Markets, diplomacy, and politics are all in motion at once, and the easy narratives won't survive contact with the next 60 days. We'll keep calling balls and strikes, win or lose. **The truth doesn't take sides — and neither do we.** That's just the truth."The truth isn't conservative or liberal. name: Alexander Heberlein
subject: Volunteer Opportunities with Matt Maasdam for Congress
body:
[image: Matt Maasdam for Congress]

Hi there,

Thank you so much for visiting our website and letting us know you’re
interested in getting involved with the *Matt Maasdam for Congress* campaign!
We’re really excited that you want to get involved.

Our community outreach is officially ramping up, and we have several
upcoming opportunities where you can jump in and make a huge impact right
away. Whether you prefer talking to folks in person or volunteering from
the comfort of home, we have an option for you:

- *Virtual Phonebank:* This Thursday, June 25th, from 5:30 PM – 8:00 PM
ET *(Join us online from anywhere!)*
- *Lansing Canvass Launch:* This Saturday, June 27th, from 1:30 PM –
4:00 PM ET
- *Livingston Canvass Launch:* This Saturday, June 27th, from 12:00 PM –
2:30 PM ET

We also have additional canvasses and phonebanks running throughout the
upcoming weeks.

If you're interested in jumping on one of these shifts, reply directly to
this email to let me know, or view the full schedule and RSVP directly
below:
Sign Up For a Volunteer Shift
<https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/Nux_N67gxEeSF9LUqU2eLQ2?results=True&date_start=06-22-2026&date_end=06-30-2026>

If you have any questions about what to expect or how to get started, just
reply directly to this email or feel free to give me a call at 734-373-9656.

Looking forward to working together!

Best,

*Alexander Heberlein*
Matt Maasdam for Congress Campaign Team
734-373-9656

Peter, Chuck Hubbard here again.
I’ve spent basically my whole life working as a local journalist and newspaper publisher. I was born and raised in this industry — my grandfather founded the Wilkes Journal-Patriot in 1932 in an effort to establish a reliable local news source for our small mountain community, and it’s been a family business ever since.
At age eight, I started out stacking newspapers in the printing room. By sixteen, I was reporting for the paper full time as a high school student. And after graduating from college, I went right back to work for the paper. I knew that my calling was connecting the folks in our community with the news that mattered to them, and I was eager to fulfill that purpose.
With over forty years in journalism, I never let my political beliefs influence my reporting. I’ve had hard words for Democrats and Republicans alike, I’ve always been honest with folks, and I’ve made sure to tell the truth no matter what was at stake.
That’s because I took pride in my work, and I always wanted to make sure that I was putting the people I served at the paper before my own beliefs and ambitions.
With her nearly thirty years in politics, I just wish Virginia Foxx could say the same.
But over the last few decades, I’ve watched her rise to power—all of it—from my home in Wilkes County, and with every race she's won, the real losers have been our people here in the High Country.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Peter, this breaks my heart:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133772625/629043114/-2009658230?refcode=em26_260622_educa_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260622_educa_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=b46de28d-3e6e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNDZkZTI4ZC0zZTZlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wnAYQ5dnPzFq9FWb7_pa7KpFvvlwtpjJoS23kpLWQvM=) In so many ways, education shaped the course of my life. I owe every opportunity I've ever had to public schools and the teachers who believed in me. I worked my way through school and became the first person in my family to graduate from college. None of that would have been possible without the education system that gave me a fair shot.

And I know my story isn't unique.

For generations, Iowa's schools were the envy of the nation. Families moved here because they wanted their children to attend our public schools. Supporting education was something Republicans, Democrats, and independents could all take pride in because we understood that investing in our children meant investing in our future.

**Somewhere along the way, we lost sight of that. Today, our state ranks in the bottom half of the country.** Meanwhile, Mariannette Miller-Meeks has attacked teachers in congressional hearings, voted for an extreme budget that would eliminate more than 100,000 teacher jobs nationwide, and proudly supports Iowa's voucher program, which has drained desperately needed resources from our public schools without any oversight or accountability.

I know we can do better. In Congress, I will work to make education a priority again, especially for rural and small-community schools. Our children deserve classrooms with the resources they need, teachers who are respected, and schools that prepare them to thrive in an increasingly competitive world.

clean_body: | = Peter, this breaks my heart: = In so many ways, education shaped the course of my life. I owe every opportunity I've ever had to public schools and the teachers who believed in me. I worked my way through school and became the first person in my family to graduate from college. None of that would have been possible without the education system that gave me a fair shot. And I know my story isn't unique. For generations, Iowa's schools were the envy of the nation. Families moved here because they wanted their children to attend our public schools. Supporting education was something Republicans, Democrats, and independents could all take pride in because we understood that investing in our children meant investing in our future. Somewhere along the way, we lost sight of that. Today, our state ranks in the bottom half of the country. Meanwhile, Mariannette Miller-Meeks has attacked teachers in congressional hearings, voted for an extreme budget that would eliminate more than 100,000 teacher jobs nationwide, and proudly supports Iowa's voucher program, which has drained desperately needed resources from our public schools without any oversight or accountability. I know we can do better. In Congress, I will work to make education a priority again, especially for rural and small-community schools. Our children deserve classrooms with the resources they need, teachers who are respected, and schools that prepare them to thrive in an increasingly competitive world. = If you've saved your payment clean_body: We’re all Democrats, but the DLCC does different work than the DNC and other Democratic committees. | | | | | ---|--- “Aren’t you the DNC?” We get this question a lot. But no, we’re not the DNC. We are the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee – or, DLCC for short – a separate entity from the other Democratic organizations like the DNC, DCCC, DSCC, or DGA. We’re all committed to electing Democrats, but the DLCC's sole focus is winning power in state legislatures – and we have a proven track record of success. | | | | | | Peter,

_**What if New Hampshire became the best state in the country for families who want to direct their own children’s education?**_

That exciting future is now within reach thanks to [House Bill 1268](https://us.list-manage.com/jU26Nl6Unxd?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)!

**This legislation restores parents as the rightful leaders of their children’s learning.**

It makes initial notifications and annual evaluations optional, ends heavy-handed district micromanagement, and protects families from having their paperwork weaponized in truancy or welfare cases.

By removing unnecessary bureaucracy while keeping sensible accountability, HB 1268 trusts parents to know what is best for their own kids.

The bill has already passed both chambers and now sits on Governor Kelly Ayotte’s desk. She has the chance to deliver a MAJOR victory for education freedom in the Live Free or Die state.

**But she needs to know you support this legislation!**

Please take a quick moment today to contact Governor Ayotte’s office and respectfully ask her to sign HB 1268 into law:
**Governor Kelly Ayotte’s Office:

✅ Share why parental choice in education matters to you, your family, or New Hampshire’s future.

✅ Emphasize that parents, not government bureaucrats, know best how to educate their children.

✅ Highlight how reducing notifications and making evaluations voluntary removes unnecessary burdens without sacrificing real accountability.

✅ Mention the bill’s important role in protecting family autonomy and aligning with our state’s proud tradition of limited government.

**Every call and email makes a difference!**

Let’s give Governor Ayotte the strong encouragement she needs to deliver this win for New Hampshire families.

[Click here to find Gov. Ayotte’s contact information today!](https://www.governor.nh.gov/contact-governor-ayotte)

For New Hampshire,

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jonnyutah4congress/field-report-june-week-4-campaign-newsletter-join-forces-with-jonny?e=c29ddb867a)

| | | | | |
# **Join Forces with Jonny**
---
| |

Hi Friend,
---
|
---
| | _Photo accreditation to_[ _KSL News/Elisabeth Haun_](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=8f46c0b31e&e=c29ddb867a)
---
| | As we get into the summer season, there are many sounds and smells in the air. The latest one? Smoke from a brushfire at the borders of Tooele, Utah, Juab counties that’s grown to almost [22,000 acres](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=f861267818&e=c29ddb867a)! The entire town of Eureka, UT remains under evacuation orders since [Saturday night](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=14f1c70974&e=c29ddb867a). I don’t know about you, but I’d say this is yet another clear sign that a data center is not in Utah’s future best interest. We have bigger problems. The health and safety of Utah’s residents, occupants, and its land comes first. Keep public land in public hands!
---
|
---
| | It was great spending time with some of you at the [Sanpete County Democratic Meet and Greet](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=fc1ce7ac97&e=c29ddb867a) for Breanne Mashek running for House District 66! [Follow and support Breanne](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=593bdd49dd&e=c29ddb867a) and help turn Sanpete County blue!
---
|
---
| | I’m so grateful to have the endorsement of Utah’s longest-serving State representative, [Carol Moss](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=6d7d207aac&e=c29ddb867a). After diligently serving her students as an educator for over 30 years, and serving the citizens of HD 34 since 2000 she’s retiring after another 26 years. Her advocacy for US veterans has helped open up better avenues of treatment for our service women and men.

As a Marine veteran, I’m proud to serve alongside each of my fellow Americans, and would love for you to join me. This campaign really is about creating a better life for all Americans where no one is left behind. Whether your time or your cash, I’m grateful to everyone that contributes to the cause.

Yours in solidarity.

Semper Fi,\- Jonny Larsen

Hey there, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

Peter,
Panic within the Trump White House over their impending demise in the 2026 midterms has reached a fever pitch and they are now pulling out every stop to try to save themselves.
Last week it was announced that President Trump ordered the US Postal Service to stop mail in voting for every state that does not provide the White House with the state's list of registered voters. The ban is now moving forward.
However, the fact that they want these voter lists should scare you even more than the cancellation of mail in voting.
The White House is trying to compile these lists so that (1) they can challenge the ballots of every Democrat and ensure their votes don't count. And (2) so that in the event of civil unrest and or the suspension of habeas corpus, the Department of Homeland Security will have a list of where all registered Democrats live.

body:
| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

subject: I’d be the first gay man in the U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
My community showed me what’s possible.
When I was a kid, reading this kind of headline would have been unimaginable, Peter:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105498?refcode=em20260622-10590&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10590%2E614464%2Ep36jjn)
Growing up as a gay person in New Hampshire, I never imagined I could live out — let alone run for U.S. Senate. **But my community showed me what's possible.** You helped me win _four times_ in one of the most competitive congressional districts in the country.
We’ve made tremendous progress since I was younger. But there’s still something we’ve never done. **We’ve never elected a gay man to the Senate.**
To be clear I’m not running for Senate just to make history. I’m in this race for the people of New Hampshire – **_all of us._** But the prospect of moving the needle of progress forward is deeply meaningful to me.
This is an opportunity for representation in the Senate. It’s also important that LGBTQ+ people have more seats at the table at a time when our rights are coming under attack.
**We can win this election for the people of New Hampshire, charting a path forward for our shared future – and we can tear down barriers and make history at the same time.**
**[Will you split a $10 contribution between my campaign and Heartland Patriots right now to stand with me in this historic fight?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105499?refcode=em20260622-10590&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=2&akid=10590%2E614464%2Ep36jjn)**
**Thank you for supporting me in this campaign, Peter.** No matter who you are, who you love, who you pray to, or where you're from — know that I'll always have your back.
With gratitude,
Chris

This is a thought experiment about political power.
Elon Musk has reportedly become the world's first trillionaire after SpaceX's public-market rise, with Forbes estimating his net worth at about $1.1 trillion and other reports placing it closer to $1.3 trillion. Most of that wealth is not cash. It is tied up in equity, companies, and market value.
But even with that caveat, the scale is unprecedented.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8438c3f4-4118-407e-9ae2-abc1034caddc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The political question is not whether Musk has $1.3 trillion sitting in a bank account.
The political question is what someone with that much wealth can finance, influence, and build.
In 2024, Musk spent roughly $277 million supporting Donald Trump and other Republican candidates, making him the largest individual donor of the election cycle. That was treated as historic, because it was historic.
But compared with trillionaire-scale wealth, $277 million is like a Netflix subscription to us.
* * *
#### The Old Billionaire Model Was Strategic Spending
Before this, we understood billionaire politics as targeted influence.
George Soros. Michael Bloomberg. Miriam Adelson. Ken Griffin. Jeff Yass. Timothy Mellon. Reid Hoffman. Tom Steyer. Sheldon Adelson when he was alive.
These people could spend enormous sums. They could fund Super PACs, ballot initiatives, media campaigns, presidential runs, Senate races, and ideological infrastructure. But even they had to choose.
They had to pick races.
They had to pick candidates.
They had to pick moments.
A billionaire worth $10 billion who spends $250 million has spent 2.5 percent of their fortune. A billionaire worth $2 billion who spends $250 million has spent 12.5 percent of their fortune. Even for the extremely rich, those are real allocations.
That is why major donors usually operate strategically. They choose a presidential race, a Senate race, a few House races, a ballot issue, a state Supreme Court race, a think tank, a legal fund, or a media project.
They buy influence by selection.
Musk's scale changes that.
* * *
#### The New Model Is Structural Power
Take only $300 billion. Just the .3 in a $1.3 trillion fortune.
Not the full trillion.
If $300 billion were parked in safe yield at 4 percent, it would generate $12 billion a year.
That is $1 billion a month.
That is about $230 million a week.
That is about $33 million a day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c4e1ecb6-f9d8-46c6-832f-fc9fed08eecf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That interest stream alone is more than enough to outspend every traditional mega-donor in American politics year after year.
And the $300 billion principal would remain intact.
This is where the political danger begins. A donor at this scale does not have to decide whether to influence the presidential race or the Senate map or the House map or state legislatures or mayoral races or school boards.
He can theoretically build a permanent political machine across all of them.
* * *
### What a National Political Machine Could Cost
There is no clean official price tag for every meaningful election in America. Federal races are tracked more clearly than state and local races. Local elections vary wildly. Some races cost almost nothing. Others cost millions. Money does not guarantee victory.
But as a thought experiment, let's say a national political operation costs about $4.4 billion a year.
That could include major support for presidential politics, competitive Senate races, House races, governor races, state legislative races, mayoral races, major city council races, ballot initiatives, local offices, candidate recruitment, polling, field operations, digital ads, opposition research, legal infrastructure, data operations, media buys, and independent expenditures.
**Now please note we are funding almost every race totally across the nation. Not just federal. EVERY RACE.**
That is an enormous amount of money.
For almost anyone else, it is impossible.
For Musk, under this model, it is less than half the annual interest on $300 billion.
He could spend $4.4 billion a year on politics and still have about $7.6 billion in annual interest left over.
Without touching the principal.
That is the difference between billionaire influence and trillionaire political capacity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/779b6c61-ac3b-4588-8789-203d3b72aba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### This Is Bigger Than Buying Ads
The danger is not just television ads.
That is the old way to think about political money.
With enough money, a private citizen can fund the whole ecosystem around elections. Candidate pipelines. Local slates. Consultants. Pollsters. Legal challenges. Ballot access fights. Opposition research. Field programs. Media platforms. Influencer networks. Data firms. Think tanks. Model legislation. Academic centers. Issue nonprofits. Lawsuits. Primary challengers. Party infrastructure. Local news alternatives.
You do not just buy one election.
You build the machinery that decides which candidates run, which issues get attention, which narratives dominate, which lawmakers get rewarded, and which politicians get punished.
At that point, money is not just campaign spending.
It is political infrastructure.
* * *
## [Part 2: How They Closed the Courts](https://substack.com/redirect/90b4af3d-b51a-4ff8-8666-713e41d5dc01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[Before the 1970s, American voters had a reasonable claim on three protections against political capture.](https://substack.com/redirect/90b4af3d-b51a-4ff8-8666-713e41d5dc01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/90b4af3d-b51a-4ff8-8666-713e41d5dc01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Citizens United Built the Opening
This is why campaign finance law matters.
The Supreme Court's Citizens United decision opened the door for corporations and other outside groups to spend unlimited money on elections through independent expenditures. Super PACs and outside groups cannot legally coordinate with candidates, but they can spend massive sums shaping the political environment around them.
That system already gave billionaires enormous power.
But a trillionaire stretches the system into something else entirely.
The law was already dangerous when billionaires could dump tens or hundreds of millions into elections. Now imagine someone who could spend billions every cycle from interest alone and keep doing it forever.
That is not normal donor politics.
That is a private political treasury.
* * *
### The Comparison to Other Donors Is the Whole Point
This is why the comparison to other political billionaires matters.
Michael Bloomberg can spend hundreds of millions. He did it.
Tom Steyer can spend hundreds of millions. He did it.
Miriam Adelson, Ken Griffin, Jeff Yass, Timothy Mellon, Reid Hoffman, George Soros, and others can shape politics. They have.
But they still operate inside limits.
They have to choose.
They have to prioritize.
They have to decide where their money has the most leverage.
Musk could operate differently. If he chose to make politics a priority, he could fund presidential races, Senate races, House races, governors, state legislatures, mayoral races, school boards, ballot initiatives, legal networks, media networks, and ideological institutions at the same time.
That is what makes this unprecedented.
It is not just that he is richer than other billionaires.
It is that his excess wealth can generate enough annual cash flow to make political spending permanent.
Not a donation.
Not a cycle.
**For-Ev-Er**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9d6befe0-c899-4abf-b24a-a00955808f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### The Leftover Money Shows the Absurdity
And here is the part that makes the scale almost impossible to process.
In this model, after spending $4.4 billion a year on national political influence, the leftover interest alone would still be about $7.6 billion a year.
**That leftover money could buy roughly 17,700 median-priced homes. Per year.**
**It could pay off average federal student loan balances for roughly 192,000 borrowers. Per Year**
**It could buy about 197,000 Tesla Model 3s. Per Year**
**It could buy about 12.7 million student laptops. Per Year**
**It could cover a full year of utilities for roughly 1 million households. Per Year**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99ee5e93-a57b-4217-8416-62f564a0f067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Again, that is not the fortune.
That is not the $300 billion.
That is not even the full annual interest.
That is the leftover interest after already funding a massive political machine.
That is the scale we are dealing with.
* * *
### The Democratic Question
I am not saying Elon Musk will do this.
I am not saying he should not be allowed to build companies, create value, or become wealthy.
I am not saying we should seize everything because someone got too rich.
That is not the point.
The point is that American democracy has never had to deal with one private citizen holding this much potential political capacity.
Governments have budgets, elections, oversight, agencies, courts, and public accountability. Parties have voters, donors, committees, and internal fights. Public companies have boards, shareholders, disclosures, and legal duties.
A private citizen with sovereign-scale wealth does not operate under the same constraints.
And if that person can use the annual return on a fraction of his wealth to fund a permanent national political machine, then we are no longer talking about ordinary campaign spending. We are not even talking about Citizens United scale spending.
We are talking about private power at democratic scale.
The question is not whether Elon Musk is good or bad.
The question is what guardrails do we need to protect our elections and democracy.

That is **this** level of wealth. Not influence. But,Dominance.
