clean_body: I fight so hard because I know what's at stake. | Fellow American - Let me tell you something they don't teach you in Washington. I grew up in the back of a bar. Not a fancy restaurant. Not a supper club. A beer joint, pool hall, and liquor store on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - the Sanitary Cafe. My parents ran it. We lived behind it. I swept the floors, wiped down the tables, and fell asleep listening to the sounds of working people winding down after a long shift at the textile mill. Neither of my parents finished high school. But they worked as if the sun were always going down, and they believed - truly believed - that their kids would go further than they did. I was the first in my family to go to college. And while I was there, I lost them both. Mom and Dad, died within two years of each other. I came home on weekends to keep the business going and helped raise my little sister, Darline, who was just 13. I didn't have a safety net. I had no choice but to climb. That's the South Carolina way. That's the American way. After law school, I put on the uniform. I became a U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate - military prosecutor, defense attorney. Even after South Carolinians sent me to the Senate, I kept serving in the Reserves. I've been to Afghanistan. I've been to Iraq. I've stood next to kids from small towns just like Central who signed up because they believe in something bigger than themselves. That's why I fight so hard, because I know exactly what's at stake. The people coming to our family's pool hall after a long week - they weren't asking for much. Safe streets. A fair shot. A chance to build something. Those are the same things Americans want today. And the folks on the other side of the aisle? They're perfectly happy to hand your neighborhood over to open borders, pile new taxes on your paycheck, and tell you to be grateful for it. I won't stand for it. Not for a second. We are in a fight for the future of this country, and it is not a time to sit on the sidelines. I didn't come from money. I came from a bar in South Carolina, a mother who worked hard, and a faith that hard work still means something in America. It still does. Thank you for standing with me. God bless you, and God bless South Carolina. Voters should not have to wonder whether a candidate’s voice and image are real.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3447%2E21716%2EVEuFK6)
**This should alarm EVERY single one of us.**
Rep. Becca Balint’s Republican opponent used AI to impersonate her by creating a fake video using her likeness, her image, and a synthetic version of her voice to make it look and sound like she said things she never said.
**That is not a normal campaign attack. It is fake. It is deceptive. And it is deeply dangerous.**
If candidates can use AI to fake a person’s voice and image, put words in their mouth, and mislead voters about what is real, then every campaign and every voter should be concerned.
[**That’s why I’m asking you today: Will you click here and split a donation between Becca Balint and my campaign to help us fight back and make clear that AI-generated lies have NO place in our democracy?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260622-1.1hNWt3&refcode=em20260622-3447&t=2&akid=3447%2E21716%2EVEuFK6)
**[STAND WITH US TODAY »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260622-1.1hNWt3&refcode=em20260622-3447&t=3&akid=3447%2E21716%2EVEuFK6)**
Look, we all know campaigns can already get nasty enough. Voters are used to seeing attack ads, bad-faith arguments, and political spin every single election cycle.
**But when AI is used to fake a candidate’s voice and image, it becomes even harder for people to know what is true. And at a time when trust in our politics is already dangerously low, that should set off alarm bells for all of us.**
The truth is, if someone wants to debate someone’s record, they should debate their record. If they want to talk about policy, they should talk about policy.
But using AI to fake a voice and image? Using technology to impersonate a candidate and confuse voters? **That crosses a serious line.**
We are speaking out forcefully on this because voters across this country deserve campaigns built on truth. Not fake voices, fake videos, and manufactured attacks. And whether or not you know Becca Balint personally, what happened to her should concern all of us.
**Because if they can fake her voice today, they can fake anyone’s voice tomorrow.**
[**If you can, please consider clicking here and splitting a donation between Becca Balint and my campaign today to help respond to this attack and stand up against deceptive AI in our elections.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260622-1.1hNWt3&refcode=em20260622-3447&t=4&akid=3447%2E21716%2EVEuFK6)

This is bigger than just one race or one attack. It’s about whether we allow bad actors to manufacture lies faster than the truth can catch up, or whether we fight back right now before it takes hold.
Thanks for always having our back,
Sarah McBride

Friend, it’s Jane. **In just eight days, four fearless climate leaders in Colorado have primaries they _need_ to win. You may be wondering why you should even care about what’s happening in Colorado, especially if you’re not from there. I’ll explain:** Big Polluters are betting we’ll ignore down-ballot races like these. While Washington is stuck in gridlock, state and local leaders are deciding whether the air we breathe gets cleaner or dirtier, whether communities transition to clean energy, and whether people are protected from corporate polluters. That’s exactly why my team and I are proudly endorsing Chela Garcia Irlando (State Senate District 34), Kenny Nguyen (House District 33), Tyler Quick (Adams County Commission District 4), and Justine Sandoval (House District 5). For the families living there, clean air can’t wait for another election, another study, or another empty promise. That’s why I need your help to reach and mobilize as many voters as possible before Election Day on June 30. Can you split a grassroots donation of at least $20 between all four campaigns today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133810581/629151523/-410490032?amount=20&refcode=ea.67e6cf70-7c6e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&ms=ea.67e6cf70-7c6e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY3ZTZjZjcwLTdjNmUtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lTG_DYeYPqbGuLeObe689IqAwT1Jungk9ULzeSTy_e0=)** | [SPLIT A $20 DONATION →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133810582/629151524/-410490032?amount=20&refcode=ea.67e6cf70-7c6e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&ms=ea.67e6cf70-7c6e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY3ZTZjZjcwLTdjNmUtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lTG_DYeYPqbGuLeObe689IqAwT1Jungk9ULzeSTy_e0=)

Now, let me introduce you to these brave leaders.
**Chela Garcia Irlando, State Senate District 34**
---
Chela’s district lives with constant pollution from the local Oil Giant, Suncor. Chela’s election would be a _literal_ breath of fresh air for residents who just want to live without the looming fear of poison on the wind.
As the leader of an environmental justice nonprofit, Chela will fight for stronger penalties for corporate polluters, real accountability, and the clean air, clean water, and safe communities every family deserves.
**Kenny Nguyen, House District 33**
---
Kenny Nguyen has the experience and backbone to stand up to Big Oil in HD-33, which includes part of Weld County — _Colorado’s #1 oil-producing county._
As a Broomfield City Councilor, Kenny fought fracking in his own community, strengthened climate resilience, and opposed fossil fuel expansion. In the legislature, he’ll fight for stricter air pollution standards, stronger regulations on Suncor and major polluters, and a moratorium on new data centers.
Kenny is also a fierce opponent of oil and gas money in our elections. **He doesn’t take a single dime from fossil fuel companies — and that’s why dark money groups have already spent more than $200,000 trying to stop him.**
**Tyler Quick, Adams County Commission District 4**
---
Tyler Quick is a researcher, a professor, and a lifelong resident of Adams County who is prepared to stand up for our democracy and our planet on the Adams County Commission.
Tyler’s deep roots in Adams County mean he doesn’t need a briefing on what polluters have done to his community — he has seen it firsthand. **From fracking to industrial pollution to the Suncor refinery in Commerce City, District 4 is on the frontlines. This is exactly the kind of seat Big Polluters want to control, and exactly the kind we cannot afford to lose.**
Tyler’s platform meets the moment with support for strong corporate accountability measures, an end to hydraulic fracking, more public transit and housing, mandated EV charging stations on new construction, stronger fees for polluters, and much more.
**Justine Sandoval, State House District 5**
---
Justine Sandoval knows environmental justice is not an abstract policy goal — it is a matter of life and death for families in District 5.
**Her district includes one of the most polluted ZIP codes in America and the Elyria-Swansea neighborhood, where residents have been forced to live with the toxic burden of the nearby Suncor refinery.**
Justine is running to make polluters pay, stop harmful projects like a proposed data center, strengthen air monitoring, invest in cumulative health impact reporting, and finally put the health of her community ahead of corporate profit.

From fracking to industrial pollution to the Suncor refinery in Commerce City, District 4 is on the frontlines. Tyler’s platform meets the moment with support for strong corporate accountability measures, an end to hydraulic fracking, more public transit and housing, mandated EV charging stations on new construction, stronger fees for polluters, and much more. _**by Ellie Leonard, Blue Amp Media Contributing Editor**_
On April 26, 2026, independent journalist [Katie Phang](https://open.substack.com/users/21818709-katie-phang?utm_source=mentions) filed a [lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/7e3fa2c1-d903-4f84-a86d-7d142291d0dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against then Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche for violating the [Epstein Files Transparency Act](https://substack.com/redirect/75c7eff4-d596-425a-ba40-e37b027d442c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Act, which was instituted on November 19, 2025, in order to produce all documents, files, records, videos, and images related to the investigation and prosecution of both Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, in summary, dictates that the files _must_ redact any personal identifying information of all victims, _must not_ redact information based on "reputational harm" of non-victims, and that all files _must_ _be released_ "not later than 30 days after the date of the enactment of this Act."
The Panicked Writer is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
As of today, it has been 209 days since the release of the Epstein Files Transparency Act. We still do not have all the files, as stated by former Attorney General Pam Bondi in her deposition.
> #### "...Congress can go in and see for themselves the 6 million pages versus why 3 million was released, and much of it was...completely unrelated to Jeffrey Epstein." \- Pam Bondi
And yet these documents were contained in the _Epstein Files._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fbcf879-d2b4-49c8-96c4-4ef7bbe0f658?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Associated Press
Bondi also clearly states that she "delegated the oversight over [the Epstein Files] to [then] Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanch." Blanche, Donald Trump's on-time defense attorney in the Stormy Daniels case--for which Trump would be charged with 34 felony counts of falsifying business records in the 1st degree--has often stated that there is no "client list," and no credible evidence of blackmail against Epstein's wealthy colleagues and friends.
> #### "The [joint statement](https://substack.com/redirect/d0c4bd2f-2e36-4e33-8600-8b5bf4332fcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the DOJ and FBI of July 6 remains as accurate today as it was when it was written. Namely, that in the recent thorough review of the files maintained by the FBI in the Epstein case, no evidence was uncovered that could predicate an investigation against uncharged third parties." \- Todd Blanche, July 7, 2025
Seventeen days later, Blanche would sit down with Ghislaine Maxwell to deliver the proffer that would eventually lead to her upgrade to a minimum-security prison camp in Texas, complete with pets and Pilates.
But a [damning piece](https://substack.com/redirect/008f89da-c76f-453a-a5be-01da23d41443?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the New York Times showed this wasn't a casual move toward transparency, but in response to a panicked sit-down in the Situation Room--normally delegated for wars and terrorist takedowns--in which Trump's "most senior advisors" frantically game-planned their next move in the suppression of the files, and namely Donald Trump's role within them. JD Vance mused that an interview with Tucker Carlson and Maxwell might relieve the pressure on the President. Blanche offered to interview her himself, stating that they could publicly release the transcript, which "might help the President if Maxwell was willing to state that Trump had not been part of any wrongdoing with Epstein." It's not known whether Carlson was offered the job, though my guess is he'd say no. Either way, one week later Blanche sat down for a two-day proffer--usually used in exchange for limited immunity or plea bargaining--in which she gave them exactly what they needed.
> #### "And as far as I'm concerned, President Trump was always very cordial and very kind to me. And I just want to say that I find - I - I admire his extraordinary achievement in becoming the President now. And I like him, and I've always liked him. So that is the sum and substance of my entire relationship with him." \- Ghislaine Maxwell
One week later, Maxwell was moved to a minimum-security prison camp in [Bryan, Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/6b3d38b1-e4a9-46cc-afde-7221ceb52562?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), typically "designed to hold short-term offenders with average sentences of five years or less," and which rarely houses sex offenders. Maxwell was sentenced to 20 years in federal prison for sex-trafficking minors.
But how exactly has Attorney General Todd Blanche violated the Epstein Files Transparency Act? And how often? With 3.5 million files, it's hard to know. But all it takes is a simple search on the DOJ's [website](https://substack.com/redirect/7c6fef77-37db-4d46-8850-d706223d3eff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to find simple examples where survivors are exposed, and their abusers are protected.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6fbcf879-d2b4-49c8-96c4-4ef7bbe0f658?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Todd Blanche - The Associated Press
In Ghislaine Maxwell's proffer, alone, we see examples of missed redactions, including a Jane Doe who was, in her own words, "clearly underage, clearly a child." Maxwell names the child, who is not redacted in the audio file, nor in the transcript. And after redacting another victim's name, she states multiple times that the victim was dating "Tony Figueroa." This immediately ID'd the victim as Virgina (Roberts) Giuffre. Another time, in the audio and transcript, it clear states: "Vir... [REDACTED]," again identifying the victim as Giuffre.
### **Unredacted Survivors**
Unfortunately these missed redactions are a common occurrence in the files, and the girls' personal information, location, and other identifying markers often get exposed. On January 31st, 2026, a day after the latest release of files, independent journalist [Aaron Parnas](https://open.substack.com/users/38485007-aaron-parnas?utm_source=mentions) discovered a stack of documents (EFTA01308844) that contained 46 pages of victims, all under the age of 18, with drivers licenses, passports, and photographs. He reported it to the DOJ immediately and the documents were redacted. Other files included Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) that _hadn 't_ been redacted. Independent journalists and teams immediately shut down all research, removing any documents from their hard drives, and contacted the DOJ.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a9c81077-47b8-4078-b191-ea2d9d5d6de5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On May 12th, a former Uzbek model named Roza came forward to speak to the House Oversight Committee at a field hearing in West Palm Beach, stating that her name had been released in the files over 500 times without her permission.
> #### "I stepped forward along other survivors, hoping those who allow this to happen would be held accountable. I kept my identity protected as 'Jane Doe.' I woke up one day with my name mentioned over 500 times. While the rich and powerful remain protected by redaction, my name was exposed to the world. Now reporters from across the globe contact me. I cannot live without looking over my shoulder. I can only imagine the long-term impact this mistake will have on my life." \- Roza
There are hundreds and thousands of examples in the files, where survivors were ignored or discounted, exposing them to further harm. This includes nude photos of survivor Juliette Bryant (EFTA00246949), the interview of Jean-Luc Brunel's bookkeeper (EFTA01111413)--which includes a list of South American girls, ages 13, 14, and 15--and emails exposing survivors' names.

Friends,
I got some kind of shocking news:
**Mike Rogers is massively outspending us.**
I'm not speechless often, but when I saw those numbers, all I could say was WOW. They're really showing their hand here, folks.
This kind of money sends one message, and it sends it loud and clear: The GOP is scared out of their minds.
They're scared that their grip on power is fading. That Democrats are going to flip Congress and effectively end Trump's second term before he has a chance to inflict the rest of his chaotic, dangerous agenda on the American people. And it's all tied up in their fear that they're going to lose in Michigan.
_And for good reason._
A new poll shows me clearly beating Rogers in a potential general matchup. And recent polling shows I'm the best-positioned Democrat to defeat him.
That's why the GOP is doubling down, calling in every favor from every megadonor on their roster, spending six figures on an ad to boost Rogers as some kind of Michigan manufacturing expert.
Don't make me laugh. They know the truth: I win on manufacturing every time.
I served as Chief of Staff on President Obama's auto rescue, where I fought to protect good jobs, bring investment home, and stand up for the generations of working families who make Michigan what it is.
And you know what? We did it. Together, we helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs. That's 200,000 people who were able to put food on the table and a roof over their heads because of the work we did.
Mike Rogers knows it, his MAGA allies know it, and more importantly, Michiganders know it.
Folks, it's clear we've got the momentum. That's why the GOP is spending themselves silly trying to slow us down.
**With your help, I 'm going to keep doing what I've always done: fighting like hell for the people of Michigan.**
Together, we're going to keep up our lead in the polls. We're going to hit back against MAGA's millions. And we're going to win where it counts.
But to do that, I need you with me every step of the way, folks. That's why I'm personally asking: **[Will you chip in to help us keep Michigan blue and flip the Senate this November?](https://substack.com/redirect/2ee5d15c-bbf8-4f70-9374-8615f79f00e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
With grit and determination,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
######

As the Vice President of Programs at Higher Heights for America, Eboni helps get Black women elected across the country. And as a leader at Mothering Justice, she helped mothers of color across our state survive and thrive, including securing paid sick time.
If elected, Eboni will be the only mother from our area in the State Senate, where **she’ll continue her work fighting for Black maternal health and reproductive rights**. This is especially necessary here in Detroit, where pregnant Black women are 4.5 times more likely to die than white women—even higher than the shameful national average.
Cori has written and spoken about how she nearly lost both of her children at childbirth due to anti-Black racism. As she explains:
> _"Every day, Black women are subjected to harsh and racist treatment during pregnancy and childbirth. Every day, Black women die because the system denies our humanity."_
We must act now to save lives. Nearly 90 percent of pregnancy-related deaths are preventable, and **I’ll keep fighting alongside Cori and Eboni for Black mothers and children, health equity, and an end to systemic racism.**
You’ve probably heard about the beautiful little boy Kohen Wiley, a 1-year-old who was killed by a white police officer last week. Outrageously, the officer shot into a car he mistakenly thought contained stolen diapers.
We will keep saying Kohen’s name and demanding justice for him and for all Black people killed by the police. We affirm that Black lives matter and are not disposable, and recommit to holding police accountable!
After police killed Michael Brown, street medic Cori Bush joined the Ferguson Uprising, where she experienced police brutality herself. This lived experience spurred her national leadership for a public safety system rooted in care rather than punishment.
**Cori, Eboni, and I will not back down in the fight for true public safety and for our constitutional rights, including the right to protest and due process.**
We are pushing for a government that invests in our communities’ needs—such as housing, healthcare, and education—rather than continually spending more of our tax dollars on state violence.

If elected, Eboni will be the only mother from our area in the State Senate, where she’ll continue her work fighting for Black maternal health and reproductive rights. Cori has written and spoken about how she nearly lost both of her children at childbirth due to anti-Black racism. As she explains: "Every day, Black women are subjected to harsh and racist treatment during pregnancy and childbirth. Every day, Black women die because the system denies our humanity." We must act now to save lives. Nearly 90 percent of pregnancy-related deaths are preventable, and I’ll keep fighting alongside Cori and Eboni for Black mothers and children, health equity, and an end to systemic racism. You’ve probably heard about the beautiful little boy Kohen Wiley, a 1-year-old who was killed by a white police officer last week. Outrageously, the officer shot into a car he mistakenly thought contained stolen diapers. We will keep saying Kohen’s name and demanding justice for him and for all Black people killed by the police. We affirm that Black lives matter and are not disposable, and recommit to holding police accountable! After police killed Michael Brown, street medic Cori Bush joined the Ferguson Uprising, where she experienced police brutality herself. This lived experience spurred her national leadership for a public safety system rooted in care rather than punishment. Cori, Eboni, and I will not back down in the fight for true public safety and for our constitutional rights, including the right to protest and due process. We are pushing for a government that invests in our communities’ needs—such as housing, healthcare, and education—rather than continually spending more of our tax dollars on state violence. Thank you for helping to get these Black moms and powerful advocates into office. They’re deeply rooted in their communities, and their lived experiences shape their empathy for people of all backgrounds. We need them in the halls of power as we build a truly multiracial democracy that serves all Americans, including the working class—rather than catering to corporate elites. In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . Hey Peter,
Last summer, Congress passed the so-called “Big Beautiful Bill,” which cut about $900 billion from Medicaid and food assistance for nearly 40 million Americans - mostly to fund tax breaks for billionaires. The bill changed the qualifying factors for Medicaid coverage, including by instituting new work requirements, and will lead to an estimated 11 million Americans losing access to health coverage. The cuts are impacting North Carolina residents, including an estimated 30,000 residents in District 13.
Everyone is frustrated by increases in the cost of care, but the changes from the “Big Beautiful Bill” are not the direction we need to go. I have worked in health care policy for almost 30 years, and I understand how important it is that we prioritize access to affordable health care across our nation. That’s why I am running for Congress: to be an independent voice, ready and willing to stand up to party bosses and wealthy elites, to be a vote for healthcare reform, and to be a voice for Americans who are tired of being left behind when it comes to the care they need to keep their families healthy.
I need your help to make sure I have the resources to reach voters across District 13 so we can show up with strong support this November.

And then when we won the Senate together it was because we still understood the urgency and necessity of the moment, and we knew Georgia could lead the way... must lead the way. It’s time to do it again. Only by regaining Congressional power can we stop what’s happening to this country. Really. The midterms are our last chance to stop MAGA and restore checks and balances. Hi,
I never planned on running for office again.
But I saw what was happening in Washington – and I couldn’t stay on the sidelines.
I jumped in the fight for U.S. Senate.
_Why?_ Because Ohioans are working harder than ever, and they’re still falling behind.
_Why?_ Because the people in power are only looking out for their rich friends and corporate interests.
_Why?_ Because National Republicans think they can buy this seat, but I refuse to let them.
With your support, we can win this race and build a country where workers share in the wealth they create, where hard work pays off, and where everyone who works hard can afford a decent life. But I need your help.
The GOP is pouring $83 million into this race to defeat me and keep their most loyal rubber stamp – my Republican opponent – in office.

Friend,
Yesterday, I talked with Nicolle Wallace on _MS NOW_ about my vision for a more just and equitable America. One where communities thrive with hope and possibility, and every child has a chance to succeed.
To achieve this vision, it must be rooted in the issues that will truly make life better for _you_ and _your_ family. But right now, we have a president who doesn't concern himself with those issues.
Donald Trump is too busy giving massive tax breaks to his billionaire buddies – and spending your tax dollars on corrupt handouts and sweetheart deals that benefit him and his family. Meanwhile, he’s making literally everything more expensive for _you_ with reckless tariffs and war.
These are the priorities of our president. He doesn’t care about you. He only cares about his own bottom line.
I want you to know that I am using every lever of power I have to hold the line against Donald Trump’s corrupt, harmful agenda – and to fight for the issues you care about most. **But to ensure that your priorities remain at the very center of my work in the Senate, it’s important that I hear from you today. You know, every now and then, my team tries to tell me how to play the game... how to be a "good politician".
But let me tell you, I'm not in this to play games or be a career politician. I'm in this to fight for what I believe in and to make a real difference.
I'm tired of the politicians who promise one thing and then do another. Who say whatever it takes to get elected, and then forget about the people who put them there.
This is Navy pilot Jen Kiggans, the Republican running in the #1 TOSS-UP race in the country.

[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)

Here’s the reality: we can't continue to conduct our campaign as usual if we aren't able to raise what we need to keep the lights on. The Democrats have unlimited pocketbooks, and we’re struggling to keep up!
During the last election, I had to empty my war chest to pull out the victory, and now we’re coming up short.
Look, I know you get a lot of these messages, and believe me, I HATE asking, but I have no other choice. We won’t win if you can’t help us out.

name: Sarah McBride (via LeftNet)
subject: I’m running
body:
My first term in Congress has been eventful to say the least.
#
It’s official.
**The paperwork has been filed, and I’m running for re-election to continue representing Delaware in the House of Representatives.**
My first term in Congress has been eventful to say the least. Elon Musk’s DOGE ransacked the federal government, Republicans slashed funding for Medicaid, food assistance, and other critical programs working families rely on, and Donald Trump started a reckless, illegal war that has caused even more pain for Americans as gas prices rose in response.
But every step of the way, I’ve been proud to stand up and fight for what’s right for Delaware. Now, this November, we have a chance to take back the majority and start passing an agenda that will put working families first for a change.
When I was first elected last year, I said that**I believe small states can do big things** — and there is no limit to what we can accomplish when we work together to make people’s lives better. That holds true now more than ever.
If we’re going to flip the House in this year’s midterms so that we can hold this administration accountable and pass a budget that centers the needs of regular Delawareans over Trump and his billionaire allies, **it has to start by keeping this seat blue.**
Republicans would love nothing more than to flip Delaware red, and I’m going to do everything I can to make sure that doesn’t happen. That’s why I just finished visiting all 57 of Delaware’s municipalities in just 57 hours — to talk to our neighbors across the state and remind them why they trusted me to represent them in Congress: to deliver lower costs, expand access to healthcare, and protect our fundamental rights.
I’m going to keep going every single day between now and November, and I’m going to need your help along the way.
**Our campaign is powered by everyday people.[Which is why today, I’m asking you to split a donation of $20.26 to my campaign to help us flip the House on Election Day.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22889?c0=leftnet_em20260622.hdw6yO&refcode=em20260622-1669&t=1&akid=1669%2E2118727%2ELsl40j)**
**[DONATE $20.26](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260622.YEVR3z&refcode=em20260622-1669&amount=5&t=2&akid=1669%2E2118727%2ELsl40j)**
Together, I know we can get it done. I’m so grateful for your support.
Thank you,
Sarah McBride

name: Wes Moore
subject: The only thing that’s ever made sense to me
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
Hey, it’s Wes. In a moment, I'm going to ask you to [**contribute to support our campaign.**](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=2&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x) But first, please give me a minute to explain what service means to me — **because the people who have spent their lives having this country's back deserve a whole lot better than what they're getting right now.** **[Donate](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=3&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)**
---
Peter,
Service is the foundation of who I am. It's not a chapter in my life or a box I checked off to get to the next rung. **It's the throughline of my life.**
I lost my father when I was 3, felt handcuffs on my wrists by 11, and, a few weeks before my 13th birthday, my mom sent me to a military academy. At a time when nothing about the world made sense to me, service did.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=4&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
I first raised my hand to serve this country when I was 17 years old. I wanted to join the military. **I was so young at the time that my mother had to sign the paperwork for me.**
Later, in 2005, when military recruitment in this country was plummeting, I volunteered to deploy as part of the 82nd Airborne Division to go to Afghanistan. One of the most dangerous places on Earth.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=5&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
My commanders praised the work we did. My fellow service members stood beside me. The United States Army recognized my service. I came home proud, and I kept choosing service.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=6&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
**Every time I've had a chance to pick something safer, something easier, something with more financial security, I instead chose to serve.**
I've never raised my hand because it was expected of me. Or because it was an easy pathway. Or because anyone told me to do it. I've always done it because I believe in this country and its promise. And I'll never waver in that belief.
The Army is not questioning my integrity. The 82nd Airborne is not questioning my integrity. The men and women I served with — the people who were there, who evaluated me, commanded me, fought alongside me — they're not questioning my integrity.
**Partisan political operatives have tried to turn my service into a vulnerability._But I don't care about attacks on me. I can take the heat._** What I worry about is how the entire military community is being hurt in this moment.
Right now, we're seeing how the Trump-Vance Administration implemented deep cuts impacting veterans' benefits, laid off thousands of veterans who worked in the federal government, ousted military leadership, and blocked officers from being rightfully promoted just because of the color of their skin or gender.
People who raised their hand to serve this country. Who put themselves in harm's way, missed birthdays and anniversaries, all to keep us safe. People who have given more to this country than anyone should ever be asked to do.
We should be lifting up people who served, not using their service as a cudgel for a political agenda. We need more leaders who are dedicated to this country, not fewer.
That's why this race matters. **I’m someone who has served, who understands what sacrifice actually looks like, who will fight for our veterans and our service members — that's what's on the line.** And to win, we need your help.
**[If you believe that service must be honored — not attacked — please make a donation today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=7&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=26&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)**
Elevate,
Wes
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260622-2.PDh_oE&amount=5&refcode=em-20260622-2&t=27&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
_Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform do not imply endorsement from the Department of Defense._

* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-footer?refcode=em-20260622-2&t=28&refcode2=1532_1086043_6tvg8x&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)**
**[Volunteer »](https://support.wesmoore.com/a/volunteer?source=em-20260622-2)**

* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=29&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/update-your-information/)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.wesmoore.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=30&akid=1532%2E1086043%2E6tvg8x)

Email us: [info@wesmoore.com](mailto:info@wesmoore.com)
BY AUTHORITY: WES MOORE FOR MARYLAND, MARY TYDINGS, TREASURER

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

clean_body: Boston, the World Cup, and a very good answer about New York. | | Friend, This is a fun one! Seth ran into a few Scottish soccer fans who are currently in Boston for the World Cup, and they had just figured out one of the most important local truths: Boston is better than New York. We have no notes. = They talked about going to a Red Sox game, how much they love the city, and how welcome they’ve felt here in Massachusetts. International sports have a way of doing this. People travel across the world, end up talking on a sidewalk in Boston, and suddenly the whole world feels a little smaller in the best possible way. **About Senator John Hoeven** A North Dakota native born in Bismarck, John Hoeven has spent his career fighting for the people of the Peace Garden State. Before coming to Washington, he served **ten years as North Dakota's governor** — growing the economy, cutting taxes, and turning North Dakota into one of the nation's top energy producers.

Since being sworn in as U.S. Senator in 2011, Hoeven has brought that same commonsense approach to Washington. He's a leading voice for **American energy dominance** , a champion for North Dakota's farmers and ranchers, and a tireless defender of our military — including Minot Air Force Base, the nation's only dual-nuclear base.

John and his wife Mikey call Bismarck home. He's fighting every day to keep North Dakota strong and America first.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76c441f7-2cb5-4bb6-b847-7ed7c8d0517f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Palantir just rocketed to **$250 billion** by helping companies extract value from user data.
The big data gold rush is here**,** but **[the company that stands to profit the most may not be Palantir](https://substack.com/redirect/76c441f7-2cb5-4bb6-b847-7ed7c8d0517f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ...
* A new disruption to smartphones gives users a share in the data profits, already facilitating +$1B in earnings and generating +$115M in revenue.
* With**[ 32,481% revenue growth](https://substack.com/redirect/76c441f7-2cb5-4bb6-b847-7ed7c8d0517f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**,**** this company is gearing up for a possible Nasdaq listing (stock ticker: **$MODE**), and pre-IPO shares are available at only $0.52/share.

It's a $1 trillion industry, and their disruptive _EarnPhone_ is now being distributed by Walmart and Best Buy.
**[The time to secure your spot at $0.52/share is now!](https://substack.com/redirect/76c441f7-2cb5-4bb6-b847-7ed7c8d0517f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Lear More](https://substack.com/redirect/76c441f7-2cb5-4bb6-b847-7ed7c8d0517f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
###### _**Disclaimers**_
###### _**Mode Mobile recently received their ticker reservation with Nasdaq ($MODE), indicating an intent to IPO in the next 24 months. An intent to IPO is no guarantee that an actual IPO will occur.**_
###### _**The rankings are based on submitted applications and public company database research, with winners selected based on their fiscal-year revenue growth percentage over a three-year period.**_
###### _***Mode cumulative revenue includes full year revenue of businesses acquired in 2025.**_
* * *
# **Maritime industry warns Iran 's Strait of Hormuz toll scheme is creating an impossible situation**
Global shipping and insurance industries are **[refusing to comply with Iran's demand](https://substack.com/redirect/9883075c-aa5b-43fb-88e2-c6854bbb4dcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that all commercial vessels register with its newly created Persian Gulf Strait Authority and carry Iranian-approved insurance to transit the Strait of Hormuz. Western underwriters say the mandate violates US sanctions and would require relying on an Iranian legal system in which the industry has zero confidence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9883075c-aa5b-43fb-88e2-c6854bbb4dcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Industry insiders are urging US negotiators to force Iran to fully dismantle its unilateral insurance requirements** and clear underwater mines from international shipping lanes before trade can realistically recover. Currently most vessels are routing through a narrower Omani channel under US military protection, creating severe bottlenecks.
* **Restoring full Hormuz transit is critical beyond oil markets.** G7 officials say normalized shipping would drive crude prices down enough to allow tougher sanctions on Russian energy without triggering painful consumer price spikes across Western economies.

* * *
# **Ilhan Omar 's $30 million suddenly disappears, financial disclosures reveal**
Rep. Ilhan Omar's newly filed 2025 financial disclosure **[dramatically revised her reported assets downward,](https://substack.com/redirect/17730467-2bcc-49ac-a324-e8b9f4a53836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from a previously stated range of $6 million to $30 million to a maximum of $125,000. Omar's office attributed the correction to an accounting error in the original filing, saying it listed business assets without corresponding liabilities and overstated her husband's net worth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/17730467-2bcc-49ac-a324-e8b9f4a53836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The sharpest revisions involve businesses linked to Omar 's husband, Tim Mynett.** A winery previously valued at up to $5 million was revised to zero, and his venture capital advisory firm -- formerly listed at up to $25 million -- was also zeroed out. Mynett's reported income dropped from between $100,000 and $1 million to somewhere between $200 and $1,000 from a now-defunct winery.
* **Questions remain unanswered about why the equity values collapsed entirely.** Omar's office says the amended disclosures were filed voluntarily and now accurately reflect the couple's financial situation.

* * *
# **' Socialist' Andy Burnham set to become UK's seventh Prime Minister in a decade**
Veteran Labour politician Andy Burnham **[is poised to replace outgoing Prime Minister Keir Starmer,](https://substack.com/redirect/e66df8be-3c52-4911-9ecc-51a4b7f04d6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who resigned after failing to maintain public confidence amid significant local election losses to Nigel Farage's Reform UK party. Burnham secured a parliamentary seat last week after winning a convincing by-election in Makerfield, clearing the path for a leadership bid that appears headed toward an uncontested coronation rather than a formal contest.

| 11:54 AM * Jun 15, 2026 * 503K Views452 Replies * 3.67K Reposts * 10.6K Likes

clean_body: Trump wants the Supreme Court’s help to kick Haitian immigrants out of the U.S. New documents show they shouldn’t rule on the case at all. | | Peter, The next target of Trump’s racist attack on immigrants in America is squarely focused on one community—Haitian nationals. Since a huge earthquake shook the country in 2010, Haitians have been granted Temporary Protected Status to live and work in the United States. Their TPS status has been renewed every year—until Kristi Noem announced that the Trump administration would strip Haitians of their status. Lower courts blocked Trump from unilaterally taking away TPS status for Haitians in America after a group of Haitian nationals argued it broke the law and discriminated against them based on race. So Trump went running straight to the corrupt and captured Supreme Court, who agreed to hear the case and took it up this spring. But now, new documents showed that Kristi Noem’s announcement was based on LIES. Haitian nationals are asking the Supreme Court to throw out the case, arguing that Noem’s decision “relied on a knowingly false statement.” She said she’d consulted with the State Department—she did not. Not only did Noem not follow lawful procedures or provide adequate justification for her announcement, it’s clear that the decision was made in order to further Trump’s anti-immigrant attacks on Black and Brown immigrants. That’s discrimination, plain and simple. More than that, it’s unconstitutional. The Haitian nationals challenging the case are right—the Supreme Court shouldn’t rule based on the Trump administration’s faulty arguments. Instead, they should kick the case back down to the lower courts to find the truth. The captured and corrupt Roberts Court has dedicated itself to furthering a rigged system. That includes putting anti-immigrant extremism over constitutional rights. But We the People can use our power to stop them from handing Trump another win. Haitian immigrants are our friends, neighbors, coworkers, and family. They deserve better than to have their TPS status illegally ripped from them. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

clean_body: Get your FREE “God's Children Are Not For Sale” t-shirt Make your first gift today and receive a FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend,I want to start with two simple words. Thank you. Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them When you make your first gift today, you help: Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children. Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation. Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children. Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis. Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers. This is how change happens. One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.**Today, that person can be you. Will you make your first gift now? Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. name: Sarah Elfreth
subject: Here is your Election Day plan, friend
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Elfreth for Maryland
body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

The moment we have been building toward is finally here. Months of hard work, grassroots organizing, and community conversations all come down to tomorrow.

Maryland polls officially open at 7:00 AM tomorrow.

To make sure we leave absolutely nothing to chance, here is your quick Election Day Checklist:

* Know the Hours: Polls are open from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM. As long as you are in line by 8:00 PM, you can cast your ballot.

* Find Your Assigned Site: Unlike early voting, you must vote at your specific, assigned local polling place on Election Day.

* Bring a Friend: Double-check that your family, friends, and neighbors have a solid plan to vote tomorrow.

FIND YOUR ASSIGNED ELECTION DAY POLLING PLACE ➔ [https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/PollingPlaceSearch]

If you have a mail-in ballot that is still on your kitchen counter, please deliver it to an official ballot drop box by 8:00 PM tomorrow OR make sure it is postmarked by June 23rd.

This is our time to protect our values, look out for our communities, and build a brighter future for Maryland. Let's make it count.

See you at the polls tomorrow morning!

Thank you,

Sarah Elfreth
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/] https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD [https://www.facebook.com/SarahforMD] https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland [https://www.instagram.com/SarahforMaryland] https://x.com/SarahforMD [https://x.com/SarahforMD]
Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. body:
at 50 days out
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260622-2947)
Peter,
Pundits are still dissecting the fallout from the Wisconsin Democratic Party state convention straw poll in which the sitting Lieutenant Governor came in first, we came in second, just four points behind, and another presumed frontrunner came in almost dead last.
Those were the headlines that dominated the last week. But today, we wanted to dig into what’s happening behind the numbers, because the deeper you go, the better it gets – for us!
They organized their supporters to come because it’s the easiest space for them to claim a lead. We put on one hell of a hospitality suite and won over the party without asking a single person to attend the convention on our behalf. Our support is organic, and we’re taking this poll as yet another sign that we can win over staunch party activists.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260622.CCiiT8&refcode=em20260622-2947&t=1&akid=2947%2E105371%2EmGc1in)_Yapping about permanent affordability_
Two months ago, three in ten voters were undecided. Today it's fewer than two in ten, and as those voters have made up their minds, they've been breaking our way. In our opponents' own internal polling, we've jumped eight points since March.
Our number isn't maxed out. It climbs every single time a new voter meets this campaign. That’s why we’re on the road seven days a week, and it’s why we’re blowing it out on social media and across digital comms channels. The strategy is working.
Fran is a once-in-a-generation candidate, and this election is a once-in-a-generation chance to take back Wisconsin for working-class people.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260622.CCiiT8&refcode=em20260622-2947&t=2&akid=2947%2E105371%2EmGc1in)_This campaign is growing so fast, it's a blur!_
We’re just 50 days away from the primary, and we’re running at full speed. Fran and the team are literally working around the clock seven days a week. Because that’s what it takes to win.
How can you help? [**Give whatever you can before June 30**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260622.CCiiT8&refcode=em20260622-2947&t=3&akid=2947%2E105371%2EmGc1in) – that’s our last public filing deadline, and it’s the most important fundraising milestone of the entire campaign.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260622.CCiiT8&amount=5&refcode=em20260622-2947&t=6&akid=2947%2E105371%2EmGc1in)**
With gratitude,
— Team Hong
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260622-2947&t=7&refcode2=2947_105371_mGc1in&akid=2947%2E105371%2EmGc1in)**

# [The Real Reason You're Paying a Fortune for Health Insurance](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3260111&post_id=203160254&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzMTYwMjU0LCJpYXQiOjE3ODIxNjk4MTEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDc2MTgxMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMyNjAxMTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.lkTi2S06XW7it8CLNfeuciZT1eiKOwi60QVrb0bM-X0)
### Eighty years ago, a doctors' lobby spent a fortune to convince America that universal healthcare was a communist plot. The lie worked. We're still paying for it -- and Washington has a way out.
| | [Melissa Chaudhry](https://substack.com/@melissa4congress)

You know the feeling. The knot in your stomach when an envelope from the insurance company shows up in the mail. The quiet math you do in the pharmacy line, deciding whether this month it's the prescription or the groceries. The financial vertigo of opening a hospital bill even though you did everything you were supposed to -- you have a job, you have "good" coverage, you followed the rules. In America, illness has a way of turning into paperwork, then panic, then debt, then shame, often before you've even finished healing.
You are not crazy. You are not imagining this. And you are not alone.
We are living through a national crisis of medical debt, premiums that outrun wages, denied claims, delayed care, and unnecessary waste of time, money, and life itself -- a system that treats the human body like a profit center instead of a sacred vessel or a public good. For decades we've been told this is just the way it is. The American way. The only way it could ever be.
**That isn 't true, and it never was.** The system we suffer under today wasn't handed down by nature or the free market. _It was built, on purpose, by people with names and addresses -- and it was defended, for nearly eighty years, by money, fear, and a lie so effective it's still doing its job._
If it was built, it can be unbuilt. So let's go back to where it started.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/62b7b9a0-0567-4326-9812-6b918c4c6751?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## 1945
After the Second World War, the United States stood at a real crossroads. Soldiers were coming home. The GI Bill had just shown, in real time, what it looked like when veterans got medical care as a matter of course instead of a matter of paperwork. Across the Atlantic, Britain was building the National Health Service out of the rubble of the Blitz. And seven months into a presidency he'd inherited rather than won, Harry Truman stood before Congress and proposed something radically simple: that no American should have to go bankrupt to see a doctor.
His plan was single-payer, funded the way we fund Social Security -- through payroll contributions -- so that every American, rich or poor, rural or urban, could walk into a hospital without doing the math first. Truman didn't frame this as charity. He framed it as infrastructure. **" Healthy citizens," he told Congress, "constitute our greatest national resource."** A healthy population wasn't a private luxury to him -- it was the foundation of a strong economy and a secure democracy.
And here's the part that feels like a gut punch: the country agreed with him. When Gallup polled Americans on Truman's plan in November 1945, **59% approved.** Only one in four opposed it. A nation exhausted by war, wary of new federal programs in general, still wanted this one. Imagine that -- before the fear campaigns, before "socialized medicine" became a household curse word, before illness became a business model and bankruptcy from it became just a normal feature of American life. The country was ready.
## The AMA Declares War
Then the American Medical Association declared war.
The AMA didn't treat Truman's proposal as a policy disagreement to be argued on the merits. It treated it as an _existential threat_ -- to its income, its autonomy, its control over the profession. And in the chill of the early Cold War, it found the perfect weapon: **fear** , dressed up as patriotism.
The AMA branded the plan "socialized medicine" -- a phrase built less to describe than to attack -- and accused the people drafting it of being "followers of the Moscow party line," when the threat of "communism" was the biggest, scariest monster in the American psyche. One widely circulated AMA pamphlet went so far as to attribute a quote to Lenin himself, falsely claiming he'd once called socialized medicine "the keystone to the arch of the socialist state." **It wasn 't true. **_**It didn 't need to be.**_ The goal was never accuracy. The goal was to make ordinary Americans afraid of the very thing that would have protected them.
When Truman pulled off his stunning 1948 reelection -- and brought new, younger, courageous Representatives to Congress with him -- the AMA didn't retreat. It escalated. That December, the AMA's House of Delegates voted to assess every one of its 140,000 members an extra $25, real money at the time, to fund what they called resistance to "the enslavement of the medical profession." With that war chest, they hired Whitaker & Baxter, the nation's first professional political consulting firm, to run a campaign that ran into the millions of dollars -- at the time, one of the most expensive lobbying efforts in American history. Their strategy was blunt: give the program an ugly name, and give the fight a villain.
The AMA called Truman's plan un-American. Truman turned the word back on them: "is it un-American," he asked, "to visit the sick, aid the afflicted, or comfort the dying?"
It was a fair question in 1948. It still is.
## It Worked. We're Still Paying for It.
The AMA's lobbying worked. By October 1950, support for national health insurance had collapsed from 59% to 24%. **The bill died** -- not because it was unpopular on its merits, but because it had been made to look monstrous. And the playbook the AMA built in those four years became the playbook for every healthcare fight that followed. The same language was recycled against Medicare in the 1960s, against universal coverage proposals through the decades since, against the Affordable Care Act in 2010. Even Dwight Eisenhower campaigned against "socialized medicine" in 1952, borrowing words built specifically to kill a plan that most Americans wanted and had nothing to do with him.
And we are still living inside the wreckage.
We pay for this every time someone delays treatment because the deductible is too steep to clear. We pay for it every time a mother stays in a job that frightens or exploits her because her child's medication is tied to that insurance card. We pay for it every time a small business loses a good employee to a corporation that can absorb healthcare costs it cannot. We pay for it every time a veteran has to fight, paperwork in hand, for care they already earned in uniform. We pay for it every time someone who did everything right -- worked hard, paid their premiums, followed every rule -- still ends up in medical debt because they had the misfortune of getting sick or injured in the richest country on earth.
## What the Constitution Actually Promises
**This is not freedom.** A person is not free if they can't leave a job because leaving means losing the insulin, the chemotherapy, the mental health care, or the coverage their child depends on. A family is not free if a single emergency can wipe out their savings, their credit, their housing, in one stroke. _A country is not free if getting sick is a financial trap for its own people._
Healthcare is not a luxury good, and it is not a reward for being useful to an employer or profitable to an insurer. It is **care for the body -- and the body is where freedom actually lives.** You cannot exercise liberty from a hospital bed you cannot afford. You cannot pursue happiness while rationing your own medication. You cannot fully participate in a democracy while you're on hold with an insurance company for days, weeks, or months, fighting for a treatment your own doctor already told you that you need.
**This is where healthcare stops being a policy preference and becomes a constitutional obligation.** The Constitution opens with a promise, not a slogan: _to establish justice, insure domestic tranquility, provide for the common defense, promote the general welfare, and secure the blessings of liberty._ The general welfare isn't an abstraction you wave at from a podium. It's whether a child sees a doctor before a fever turns into an emergency. It's whether an elder ages with dignity instead of fear. It's whether a disabled person gets to live a full life rather than a managed one. It's whether a mother survives childbirth -- without going bankrupt -- in the wealthiest country in human history. It's whether a worker can change jobs, start a business, or care for a sick parent without that decision costing them their coverage.
For nearly eighty years, a powerful industry has told us that guaranteeing those things is impossible, unaffordable, un-American.
I'd put it the other way.
What's un-American is a system where corporations profit from denying care. What's un-American is making people beg for treatment through a phone tree, then get denied by an AI without even the bare consideration of five minutes of human attention. What's un-American is letting medical debt destroy a family while executives and shareholders extract parasitic wealth from human vulnerability.
**None of this is a personal failure.** It is not because families budgeted badly, or workers lacked discipline, or small business owners didn't plan well enough. This is the _entirely predictable result_ of a political system that let healthcare profiteers write the rules eighty years ago -- and has been protecting their handiwork ever since.
That's why this history matters. Not as trivia: as **diagnosis**. And a correct diagnosis is the first thing you need before you can actually heal anything.
## Military Healthcare: Where It's Already Happening
I know this system from more than one angle. My husband was a paramedic, emergency medical technician, and first responder as well as an Army medic trainer, and my father spent his career in Navy medicine, so for our family this has never been an abstraction -- I've watched American healthcare from inside the exam room as well as from the patient's side of the billing desk. My father was a Navy doc, and for as long as I can remember, since I was a small child, he told me the same thing in one form or another: that he could not imagine what it would do to a person to have to check whether their patient could pay before deciding how to treat them. He never had to make that calculation. In the military health system, you treat the sailor, the soldier, the spouse, the kid with the broken arm, in front of you -- full stop -- and the accounting happens somewhere else, later, without anyone going bankrupt over it.
That system isn't hypothetical. It's real, it's running right now, and it covers more than **nine million** active-duty service members, retirees, and their families. Which means the same country that tells the rest of us universal healthcare is too complicated, too expensive, too radical to guarantee has quietly been running a working, no-means-tested version of it for our military families for decades. We don''t have to invent anything. We already know how to do this. We've simply decided, as a matter of policy, that some Americans get that peace of mind and the rest of us have to fight an insurance company for it.
That isn't a technical problem. It's a moral one -- and it is, frankly, a matter of national shame.
## Here's An Example for How This Can Work
Here's the part nobody tells you: we already know how to do this. Right now, today, there is a fully designed, fully costed plan sitting in the Washington State Legislature that would **cover every single person in this state** -- every resident, regardless of immigration status, age, income, employment, or pre-existing condition -- with comprehensive coverage: medical, mental health, dental, vision, reproductive care, the whole picture, free at the point of service. No premiums. No deductibles. No copays. No surprise bills.
It's called the Washington Health Trust (SB 5335 in the Senate, HB 1445 in the House), and the organization that has spent years building the case for it, testifying for it, and refusing to let legislators look away from it is [Whole Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/82d4ce0a-afea-46c6-bb6b-4ae8ae690a3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Independent economic analysis estimates the Trust would save the state somewhere between $5 and $13 billion every single year, by cutting out the duplicate(/triplicate, or even quadriplicate) billing departments, the competing insurance bureaucracies, the claim-denial algorithms, and the layer of pure profit-extraction that our current system pays for instead of paying for care.
Sit with that for a second. We are not choosing between covering everyone and saving money. **We are currently paying** _**more**_** -- much, much more -- to bankrupt hundreds of thousands of our neighbors, to needlessly contribute to tens of thousands of preventable deaths a year, and to burn millions of collective hours of people's lives on hold with insurance companies, all so an unnecessary, baroque, and frankly parasitic layer of middlemen can extract a profit from our sickness.**
For God's sake. We can do better than this. We are choosing not to.
Here's a fact for the moment: this summer, Seattle is hosting matches in the FIFA World Cup -- the biggest sporting event on Earth, 48 nations, the whole world watching. It's become one of those facts that fans keep tallying up nation by nation as they watch: of those 48 countries, t _he United States is the only one that doesn 't guarantee its people universal healthcare_. We're hosting the party, and we're the only one where a player injured in the game has to pay through the nose to see a doctor afterwards.
I am a proud endorser of [Whole Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/82d4ce0a-afea-46c6-bb6b-4ae8ae690a3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I've supported this work for years, long before I was a candidate for anything, because I believe it is simply the right thing to do for the people of this state. And I have personally taken the [Patients Over Profits pledge](https://substack.com/redirect/573d084f-a4fe-4b27-9ef6-f2880f8e3d4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- a commitment to refuse contributions over $200 from the executives, lobbyists, and PACs of the corporate healthcare industry that has spent eighty years and counting making sure people like us stay afraid of the very reforms that would help us.
I won't take their money. I will take their fight.
## Care. Courage. The Constitution.
I am running for Congress because people in this district are tired of being told to wait while their lives get harder and the powerful get away with more. I am running because "liberty and justice for all" does not come with an asterisk. I am running because a government that exists to secure our rights also has to protect the actual conditions that let people live, work, parent, age, and participate as free human beings -- and that means **guaranteeing healthcare, not rationing it.**
That means ending medical debt. That means standing up to insurance companies and pharmaceutical profiteers instead of taking their checks. That means fully funding the care our veterans already earned. That means protecting reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. That means treating care work -- for children, for elders, for the disabled, for the sick -- as infrastructure, not as charity we hope someone else provides.
I don't take corporate PAC money. I don't take money from foreign interests or defense contractors. I've taken the Patients Over Profits pledge for the same reason Truman fought the AMA and lost: the moment you let an industry write the checks, you've already lost the argument before it starts. I'd rather lose a fundraising email than lose my ability to tell you the truth.
We already know how to guarantee healthcare without bankrupting anyone -- we've been quietly doing it for military families for decades. The only reason we haven't done it for everyone else is that a small number of billionaires, and the industries that bankroll their favorite politicians, profit from keeping the rest of us confused, afraid, and fighting each other instead of fighting them. That isn't an accident or a mystery. It's billionaire capture of our political system, plain and simple, and it has to end.
The fight ahead is hard, because the money on the other side is enormous -- the same money, more or less, that's been winning this argument since 1949.
The moral question underneath it has never changed.
**Do we believe human beings have dignity, or not?**
**Do we believe freedom belongs to everyone, or only to the healthy and the wealthy?**
**Do we believe government exists to secure our rights, or to protect the business model of the industries that profit from our pain?**
I know my answer. Care. Courage. The Constitution. A healthcare system that serves the people. A government that finally answers to them. A country where "liberty and justice for all" means _**exactly**_ what it says -- to every single one of us, no asterisks.
